title: A gait foundation model for prediction of multisystem health phenotypes from 3D skeletal motion
zh_title: 步态基础模型：3D骨骼运动预测多系统健康表型
summary: 基于3,328名深度表型成人、单深度相机采集的3D骨骼运动数据，构建步态基础模型，预测跨18个身体系统的健康表型。
key_points: 单深度相机记录5项运动任务，共3,328名成人
学习式嵌入优于节奏、步幅等人工特征
用于预测握力、睡眠质量等18个系统表型
reason: Nature Medicine同行评审，三千余人深度表型队列+基础模型，但外部验证情况未明
abstract: Gait is increasingly recognized as a vital sign, yet current approaches treat it as a symptom of specific pathologies rather than a systemic biomarker. Here we developed a gait foundation model for three-dimensional skeletal motion, which was recorded via a single-depth camera during 5 motor tasks, from 3,328 deeply phenotyped adults. Our purpose was to capture the full pattern of a person’s movement and use it to predict health phenotypes such as grip strength and sleep quality across 18 body systems. Gait is conventionally described by engineered features (for example, calculated measurements such as cadence and stride length), which may fail to capture the fine detail of how a person moves. Our model instead translates movement into learned embeddings: sets of numbers that describe how all body joints move together over time. Learned embeddings outperformed engineered features for prediction of age (Pearsonʼs r = 0.69), body mass index ( r = 0.91) and visceral adipose tissue area ( r = 0.83), and embeddings significantly predicted 1,887 of 3,210 tested phenotypes. Relative to a baseline model using age, body mass index, visceral adipose tissue and height alone, gait embeddings improved prediction in all 18 systems in males and 17 of 18 in females, as well as prediction of clinical diagnoses and medication use. Anatomical ablation analyses revealed that leg dynamics dominated metabolic and frailty predictions, and torso dynamics encoded sleep and lifestyle phenotypes. These findings establish gait as an independent, multisystem biosignal, motivating integration of gait analysis into routine clinical assessment as a scalable, passive vital sign. A gait foundation model, developed using three-dimensional skeletal motion data from 3,328 adults, predicts a wide array of clinical characteristics and diagnoses, including cardiometabolic, mental health and frailty phenotypes.
zh_abstract: 步态日益被视为一种生命体征，但当前方法仍将其视为特定病理的症状，而非系统性生物标志物。在此，我们开发了一个针对三维骨骼运动的步态基础模型（gait foundation model），该运动由单深度相机在5项运动任务中记录，来自3,328名深度表型成人。我们的目的是捕捉一个人运动的完整模式，并用其预测跨越18个身体系统的健康表型，如握力和睡眠质量。步态通常由工程化特征（例如，计算得到的步频和步幅等测量值）描述，这些特征可能无法捕捉一个人如何运动的精细细节。我们的模型则将运动转换为学习到的嵌入：一组描述所有身体关节随时间共同运动方式的数值。学习到的嵌入在预测年龄（Pearson r = 0.69）、体重指数（r = 0.91）和内脏脂肪组织面积（r = 0.83）方面优于工程化特征，并且嵌入显著预测了3,210个受测表型中的1,887个。相对于仅使用年龄、体重指数、内脏脂肪组织和身高的基线模型，步态嵌入改善了男性全部18个系统和女性18个系统中17个系统的预测，以及临床诊断和药物使用的预测。解剖消融分析显示，腿部动力学主导代谢和衰弱预测，而躯干动力学编码睡眠和生活方式表型。这些发现确立了步态作为一种独立的多系统生物信号，推动将步态分析整合到常规临床评估中，作为一种可扩展的被动生命体征。一个利用3,328名成人三维骨骼运动数据开发的步态基础模型可预测广泛的临床特征和诊断，包括心脏代谢、心理健康和衰弱表型。

title: Wrist photoplethysmography encodes dietary information

abstract: Whether wearable photoplethysmography (PPG) encodes dietary information remains unknown. We trained a language model on 1.1M meals to align PPG with meal descriptions. Near-meal PPG carries a meal-specific signal beyond individual traits; predictability decreases farther from meals. This transfers to dietary tasks: PPG increases AUC by 11% for a caloric-intake proxy and satiety across held-out and independent cohorts. Wearable PPG may augment text-based logging, compensating for brief descriptions.
zh_abstract: 可穿戴光电容积脉搏波描记法（PPG）是否编码饮食信息仍未知。我们在110万餐食上训练了一个语言模型，使 PPG 与餐食描述对齐。进餐附近的 PPG 携带超越个体特征的餐食特异性信号；离进餐越远，可预测性越低。这可迁移至饮食任务：在留出队列和独立队列中，PPG 使热量摄入替代指标和饱腹感的 AUC 提高11%。可穿戴 PPG 可能增强基于文本的记录，弥补描述简短的问题。

title: A statistical framework for evaluating the repeatability and reproducibility of large language models.
source: PubMed · Journal of the American Medical Informatics Association : JAMIA
zh_title: 评估大语言模型可重复性与再现性的统计框架
summary: 提出含四项指标的统计框架及Python包llmReproScore，从语义与内部两维度量化LLM输出变异。
key_points: 按FDA术语定义四项可重复性/再现性指标
分语义变异与token生成确定性两维度
以USMLE诊断推理输出为示例验证

abstract: [Journal of the American Medical Informatics Association : JAMIA] Systematic evaluation of variability in large language model (LLM)-generated outputs is critical for assessing their reliability. We developed a general statistical framework and Python package (llmReproScore) for quantifying the repeatability and reproducibility of LLM outputs. Following US Food and Drug Administration terminology, our framework establishes four metrics for quantifying LLM repeatability and reproducibility along two dimensions: semantic and internal. Semantic metrics quantify variability in the meaning of LLM-generated outputs, whereas internal metrics quantify variability in token-generation certainty. We validated these metrics, and as an illustrative use case, applied them to diagnostic reasoning outputs generated across LLMs and prompting strategies using US Medical Licensing Examination questions and 90 real-world rare disease cases from the Undiagnosed Diseases Network. Validation results showed that semantic scores aligned with human ratings (Spearman ρ = 0.88 for repeatability and 0.66 for reproducibility) and confirmed that internal metrics capture variability in token-generation certainty. In the illustrative use case, LLM repeatability was generally not associated with accuracy, suggesting that LLM output variability and accuracy capture distinct dimensions of model performance. The proposed metrics can be used to characterize LLM output variability and systematically compare models, prompts, and generation settings. These comparisons can inform more rigorous selection of LLM configurations based on repeatability and reproducibility. We developed and validated generalizable metrics for quantifying LLM output variability. The proposed metrics can complement accuracy-based evaluation to inform experimental design and support more rigorous comparison and selection of models, prompts, and generation settings.
zh_abstract: [Journal of the American Medical Informatics Association : JAMIA] 系统评估大语言模型（LLM）生成输出的变异性对于评估其可靠性至关重要。我们开发了一个通用统计框架和Python包（llmReproScore），用于量化LLM输出的可重复性和可再现性。遵循美国食品药品监督管理局（US Food and Drug Administration）的术语，我们的框架沿两个维度建立了四个指标来量化LLM可重复性和可再现性：语义维度和内部维度。语义指标量化LLM生成输出含义的变异性，而内部指标量化词元生成确定性的变异性。我们验证了这些指标，并作为一个示例性用例，将其应用于使用美国医师执照考试（US Medical Licensing Examination）问题和来自Undiagnosed Diseases Network的90例真实世界罕见病病例、跨LLM和提示策略生成的诊断推理输出。验证结果表明，语义评分与人工评分一致（可重复性的Spearman ρ = 0.88，可再现性的Spearman ρ = 0.66），并确认内部指标捕捉了词元生成确定性的变异性。在示例性用例中，LLM可重复性通常与准确性无关，提示LLM输出变异性和准确性捕捉的是模型性能的不同维度。所提出的指标可用于表征LLM输出变异性，并系统比较模型、提示和生成设置。这些比较可为基于可重复性和可再现性更严格地选择LLM配置提供信息。我们开发并验证了用于量化LLM输出变异性的可推广指标。所提出的指标可补充基于准确性的评估，为实验设计提供信息，并支持更严格地比较和选择模型、提示和生成设置。

title: Clinical predictions using artificial intelligence in neurosurgery and its subspecialties: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
zh_title: 神经外科人工智能临床预测的系统综述与Meta分析
summary: 系统检索2015–2026年神经外科AI临床预测研究，按亚专科与诊疗路径阶段汇总AUC等指标并评估偏倚风险。
key_points: PRISMA检索PubMed与Ovid同行评审原研
随机效应模型汇总AUC及准确性等指标
按诊断、预后、预测分类并评定证据等级
reason: 系统综述/Meta分析汇总多研究，按规则最高6分
abstract: [British journal of neurosurgery] Artificial intelligence (AI) models for clinical prediction are proliferating across neurosurgery, but their aggregate discriminative performance, distribution along the care pathway and methodological quality are unclear. We systematically reviewed and meta-analysed these studies in neurosurgery and its subspecialities along with their risk of bias appraisal. We performed a PRISMA search on PubMed and Ovid for peer-reviewed original studies (2015-2026) using AI to predict a clinical outcome in neurosurgical populations. Metrics (primary- AUC; secondary- accuracy, sensitivity, specificity, c-index) were pooled using random effects modelling, overall, by subspeciality and care-pathway stage. Each study was classified as diagnostic, prognostic or forecasting and was assigned an evidence level. Clinical prediction task sub-stratification analysis was performed. Risk-of-bias was assessed using PROBAST. PROSPERO registered: CRD420261436614. 1063 studies were included. Across 451 (42.2%) studies reporting AUC, pooled discrimination was 0.86 (95% CI: 0.849-0.862), ranging from 0.84 (spine) to 0.87 (neuro-oncology), with extreme heterogeneity (I2 98.6%, τ2=0.27; 95% prediction interval: 0.68-0.94). Performance varied by clinical pathway stage, highest for diagnosis, grading and molecular tasks and lowest for post-operative tasks; pre-diagnosis, pre-operative and intra-operative applications were sparse, and treatment models were confined to neuro-oncology. Only 51 studies (4.8%) were using prospective data with external validation, whereas 619 (58%) rested on internal validation alone or no validation. 89% studies were at high risk-of-bias, driven by the analysis domain. Pooled discrimination was unchanged (AUC: 0.86%) when restricted to externally validated or non-high-risk studies. AI models report high performance across all the neurosurgical subspecialities, concordant across AUC, accuracy, sensitivity and specificity and robust to risk-of-bias stratification. Performance is highest for imaging-anchored diagnostic tasks and lowest at decision-facing post-operative stage. However, the literature is dominated by optimism-prone, internally-validated and poorly calibrated models with extreme heterogeneity. External validation, calibration analysis and reporting guidelines adherence remain prerequisites for clinical adoption.
zh_abstract: 用于临床预测的人工智能（artificial intelligence, AI）模型在神经外科领域迅速增多，但其总体判别性能、沿诊疗路径的分布及方法学质量尚不明确。我们系统综述并荟萃分析了神经外科及其亚专科中的这些研究，并评估其偏倚风险。我们按照PRISMA在PubMed和Ovid上检索使用AI预测神经外科人群临床结局的同行评议原创研究（2015-2026年）。采用随机效应模型合并指标（主要指标AUC；次要指标准确率、灵敏度、特异度和c指数），分别进行总体、按亚专科和按诊疗路径阶段的合并。每项研究被分类为诊断性、预后性或预测性，并分配证据等级。进行了临床预测任务亚分层分析。使用PROBAST评估偏倚风险。PROSPERO注册号：CRD420261436614。共纳入1063项研究。在451项（42.2%）报告AUC的研究中，合并判别性能为0.86（95% CI：0.849-0.862），范围为0.84（脊柱）至0.87（神经肿瘤学），异质性极大（I2 98.6%，τ2=0.27；95%预测区间：0.68-0.94）。性能随临床路径阶段而变化，在诊断、分级和分子任务中最高，在术后任务中最低；诊断前、术前和术中应用稀少，治疗模型仅限于神经肿瘤学。仅51项研究（4.8%）使用前瞻性数据并进行外部验证，而619项（58%）仅依赖内部验证或无验证。89%的研究存在高偏倚风险，主要由分析域驱动。当仅限于外部验证或非高风险研究时，合并判别性能未变（AUC：0.86%）。AI模型在所有神经外科亚专科中均报告高性能，在AUC、准确率、灵敏度和特异度方面一致，且对偏倚风险分层稳健。性能在以影像为基础的诊断任务中最高，在面向决策的术后阶段最低。然而，文献主要由易产生乐观偏倚、仅内部验证且校准不良的模型主导，并具有极大异质性。外部验证、校准分析和报告指南依从性仍是临床采用的前提条件。

title: Deep Learning for AD Risk Screening and Progression Prediction.
zh_title: 深度学习用于阿尔茨海默病风险筛查与进展预测
summary: 在722名中国参与者队列中检验西方样本预训练分类器的可迁移性，并关联进展、认知与血浆标志物。

abstract: [Advanced science (Weinheim, Baden-Wurttemberg, Germany)] The rise of Alzheimer's disease (AD) immunotherapies underscores the need for accessible, time-efficient biomarkers for early diagnosis. MRI-based deep learning shows promise in this regard, yet few models have undergone comprehensive clinical validation. Using the SILCODE cohort (722 Chinese participants, 1,105 scans), we test the transportability of our classifier (pretrained on Western samples) to an independent Chinese cohort without retraining. The associations between risk scores and disease progression, cognitive performance, and plasma biomarkers are examined. In addition, an interpretable framework is developed to generate individualized brain risk maps and identify subtypes. The model classifies AD with an AUC of 0.913 and 95.2% sensitivity, identifying 90.5% of high-risk individuals 2-3 years before clinical diagnosis. Risk scores correlate significantly with cognitive and plasma indices, particularly p-tau 217. Brain risk maps reveal AD subtypes, including a subgroup with rapid cognitive decline. These findings establish a population-robust, clinically relevant MRI-based model for early AD detection and risk stratification.
zh_abstract: [Advanced Science (Weinheim, Baden-Wurttemberg, Germany)] 阿尔茨海默病（Alzheimer's disease, AD）免疫疗法的兴起凸显了对可及、省时的早期诊断生物标志物的需求。基于MRI的深度学习在这方面显示出前景，但很少有模型经过全面的临床验证。使用SILCODE队列（722名中国参与者，1,105次扫描），我们在无需重新训练的情况下检验我们的分类器（在西方样本上预训练）向一个独立中国队列的可迁移性。检查风险评分与疾病进展、认知表现和血浆生物标志物之间的关联。此外，开发了一个可解释框架以生成个体化脑风险图并识别亚型。该模型分类AD的AUC为0.913，灵敏度为95.2%，可在临床诊断前2-3年识别出90.5%的高风险个体。风险评分与认知和血浆指标显著相关，尤其是p-tau 217。脑风险图揭示AD亚型，包括一个认知快速下降的亚组。这些发现确立了一个人群稳健、具有临床相关性的基于MRI的模型，用于早期AD检测和风险分层。

title: An explainable, bias-audited machine learning model to detect hidden hepatitis C from region-wide real-world health records
zh_title: 可解释模型从区域健康档案识别隐匿丙肝
summary: 基于西班牙安达卢西亚人群健康数据库2.5万余例丙肝患者，训练可解释提升机模型识别未诊断感染，并在2024年独立人群代表性样本中评估。

abstract: Background: Although direct-acting antivirals have transformed hepatitis C virus (HCV) treatment, 25-30% of active infections in Spain remain undiagnosed. We aimed to develop and validate an interpretable machine-learning model to identify undiagnosed HCV infection using only data already recorded within the health system. Materials and Methods: We conducted a retrospective, population-based cohort study using the Andalusian Population Health Database (BPS). Individuals diagnosed with HCV between 2017 and 2024 (n=25,028) were matched, up to 10:1, to controls by birth year, sex, and health district. An Explainable Boosting Machine was trained on 2017-2022 data, with a threshold set in a 2023 validation set to guarantee [≥]60% sensitivity, then evaluated unmodified in an independent, non-matched, population-representative 2024 sample approximating real-world screening. Predictors comprised chronic-disease diagnoses and laboratory summary statistics recorded [≥]30 days before the index date; age and sex were excluded as matching variables. Predictors reflecting socioeconomic proxies or matching artefacts (pharmaceutical co-payment category, a zone-level deprivation index) were removed after explainability review. Results: In the independent test set, the model achieved an AUC of 0.837 (0.826 in validation), sensitivity 63.5%, specificity 91.8%, positive predictive value 7.0%, and negative predictive value 99.6%. Leading predictors were minimum alanine aminotransferase, HIV infection, dependence on non-tobacco substances, and platelet-count statistics, forming a clinically coherent, laboratory- and comorbidity-driven profile. Conclusion: An explainable model built exclusively from routine electronic health record data can identify undiagnosed HCV infection with discrimination comparable to previously published tools, evaluated under conditions approximating true population prevalence. Bias-auditing was feasible without sacrificing interpretability, supporting a scalable, equity-conscious instrument for the final phase of HCV elimination.
zh_abstract: 【背景】尽管直接抗病毒药物已改变丙型肝炎病毒（HCV）的治疗格局，西班牙25-30%的活动性感染仍未确诊。我们旨在开发并验证一个可解释的机器学习模型，仅使用卫生系统内已记录的数据来识别未诊断的 HCV 感染。【方法】我们开展了一项回顾性、基于人群的队列研究，使用安达卢西亚人口健康数据库（BPS）。将2017年至2024年间诊断为 HCV 的个体（n=25,028）按出生年份、性别和卫生区与对照进行匹配，匹配比例最高为10:1。在2017-2022年数据上训练了一个可解释提升机（Explainable Boosting Machine），在2023年验证集中设定阈值以保证≥60%的灵敏度，然后在独立的、非匹配的、具有人群代表性的2024年样本中不经修改进行评估，该样本近似真实世界筛查。预测变量包括索引日期前≥30天记录的慢性病诊断和实验室汇总统计量；年龄和性别作为匹配变量被排除。反映社会经济替代指标或匹配伪影的预测变量（药品共付类别、区域层面剥夺指数）在可解释性审查后被移除。【结果】在独立测试集中，模型达到 AUC 0.837（验证集中为0.826）、灵敏度63.5%、特异度91.8%、阳性预测值7.0%和阴性预测值99.6%。主要预测变量为最低丙氨酸氨基转移酶、HIV 感染、非烟草物质依赖和血小板计数统计量，形成临床一致、由实验室和合并症驱动的特征谱。【结论】一个完全基于常规电子健康记录数据构建的可解释模型能够识别未诊断的 HCV 感染，其区分能力与既往发表的工具相当，并在接近真实人群患病率的条件下进行了评估。偏倚审计在不牺牲可解释性的情况下可行，支持一种可扩展、具有公平意识的工具用于 HCV 消除的最后阶段。

summary: 用Gemma-3-27B-it少样本提示将64份德国老年科门诊报告改写为患者友好版本，并与人类专家版本进行盲法对比评估。

abstract: [Journal of medical Internet research] Effective communication between clinicians and patients plays an important role in the successful delivery of health care. In geriatric medicine, where multimorbidity, polypharmacy, and functional limitations often make treatment plans complex, AI simplifications of clinical reports into patient-friendly language offer a promising way to improve communication. This study investigated whether AI could generate patient-friendly simplifications of outpatient reports that were comparable to those authored by human experts. Gemma-3-27B-it, an instruction fine-tuned open-source large language model (LLM) by Google, was used, and few-shot prompting was applied to enable the generation of patient-friendly simplifications of 64 deidentified geriatric outpatient reports written in German while preserving clinical meaning. LLM-generated simplifications were compared with those produced by 2 medical experts in a blinded evaluation. Quality was assessed using three approaches: (1) embedding-based semantic similarity to the original report, (2) blinded expert review by 2 clinicians, and (3) review by patient representatives, with the latter 2 using a standardized Likert-scale questionnaire. AI-generated simplifications were comparable to geriatrician-authored simplifications regarding semantic similarity (P=.02) and were preferred by patient representatives (P<.001) as well as one expert reviewer (P=.001). Expert reviewers perceived physician-authored simplifications as more complete (P<.001), a finding that correlated with text length (P<.001). This study demonstrates the feasibility of using LLMs via few-shot prompting to simplify medical reports for improved perceived patient comprehension in geriatric care. Future prospective studies should examine whether such AI-driven simplifications positively impact objective health-related outcomes, adherence, and patient engagement.
zh_abstract: [Journal of Medical Internet Research] 临床医生与患者之间的有效沟通在医疗服务的成功提供中发挥重要作用。在老年医学中，多病共存、多重用药和功能受限常使治疗计划复杂化，AI 将临床报告简化为患者友好的语言，为提高沟通提供了有前景的方法。本研究调查了 AI 是否能生成与人类专家撰写的简化报告相当的、患者友好的门诊报告简化版本。研究使用 Google 的指令微调开源大语言模型（LLM）Gemma-3-27B-it，并应用少样本提示，使其能够在保留临床意义的前提下，对64份去标识化的德语老年门诊报告生成患者友好的简化版本。LLM 生成的简化版本与2名医学专家生成的简化版本在盲法评估中进行了比较。质量通过三种方法评估：（1）基于嵌入的与原始报告的语义相似度，（2）由2名临床医生进行的盲法专家评审，（3）由患者代表进行的评审，后两者使用标准化 Likert 量表问卷。AI 生成的简化版本在语义相似度方面与老年科医生撰写的简化版本相当（P=.02），并且更受患者代表（P<.001）以及一名专家评审者（P=.001）的青睐。专家评审者认为医生撰写的简化版本更完整（P<.001），这一发现与文本长度相关（P<.001）。本研究证明通过少样本提示使用 LLM 简化医疗报告以提高老年护理中患者感知理解度的可行性。未来前瞻性研究应检验此类 AI 驱动的简化是否对客观健康相关结局、依从性和患者参与产生积极影响。

title: Evaluation of PainWaive: a consumer-grade EEG headset for remote EEG monitoring and neurofeedback research in chronic pain

key_points: 80人完成两次静息态脑电，与科研级LiveAmp对照
α功率与峰α频率ICC 0.72–0.93，β/θ较低

abstract: Affordable electroencephalography (EEG) headsets could widen access to EEG-based treatment and assessment, but require rigorous validation. We evaluated PainWaive, a custom-developed 2-channel central scalp EEG headset designed for remote EEG monitoring and neurofeedback research in chronic pain. Eighty participants completed two resting-state EEGs using PainWaive and a research-grade system (LiveAmp). Alpha, beta and theta power, and peak alpha frequency (PAF), were derived from homologous central channels. PainWaive demonstrated good-to-excellent test-retest reliability for alpha power and PAF (ICCs = 0.72–0.93), with beta and theta ranging from moderate-good (ICCs = 0.42–0.76). Across 160 home-based neurofeedback sessions in two chronic pain samples, reliability was good-to-excellent across metrics (ICCs = 0.72–0.88). Spectral-shape correlations between PainWaive and LiveAmp were excellent ( r > 0.91). Cross-device agreement was moderate-to-good for alpha power and PAF (ICCs = 0.53–0.74), but weaker for beta and theta (ICCs = 0.16–0.51). Sensitivity analyses showed alpha power and PAF were robust across choices, whereas beta and theta agreement varied by pipeline. Overall, PainWaive demonstrated reliable measurement of central scalp EEG metrics, supporting repeated within-device monitoring. Cross-device findings showed correspondence with research-grade EEG for some measures but should not be interpreted as establishing direct numerical interchangeability between systems. These findings provide a technical foundation for future remote EEG and neurofeedback studies in chronic pain.
zh_abstract: 可负担的脑电图（EEG）头戴设备可能扩大基于 EEG 的治疗和评估的可及性，但需要严格验证。我们评估了 PainWaive，一种自定义开发的 2 通道中央头皮 EEG 头戴设备，设计用于慢性疼痛中的远程 EEG 监测和神经反馈研究。八十名参与者使用 PainWaive 和研究级系统（LiveAmp）完成了两次静息态 EEG。Alpha、beta 和 theta 功率以及峰值 alpha 频率（PAF）来自同源中央通道。PainWaive 对 alpha 功率和 PAF 表现出良好至优秀的重测信度（ICCs = 0.72–0.93），beta 和 theta 为中等至良好（ICCs = 0.42–0.76）。在两个慢性疼痛样本的 160 次居家神经反馈会话中，各指标的信度为良好至优秀（ICCs = 0.72–0.88）。PainWaive 与 LiveAmp 之间的频谱形状相关性极好（r > 0.91）。跨设备一致性对 alpha 功率和 PAF 为中等至良好（ICCs = 0.53–0.74），但对 beta 和 theta 较弱（ICCs = 0.16–0.51）。敏感性分析显示，alpha 功率和 PAF 在不同选择下稳健，而 beta 和 theta 的一致性随处理流程而变化。总体而言，PainWaive 对中央头皮 EEG 指标表现出可靠测量，支持设备内重复监测。跨设备发现显示某些指标与研究级 EEG 具有对应性，但不应被解释为确立了系统之间的直接数值互换性。这些发现为未来慢性疼痛中的远程 EEG 和神经反馈研究提供了技术基础。

title: Deep learning optimisation for cardiology: Neural Architecture Search-driven arrhythmia classification with electrocardiograms.
zh_title: 神经网络架构搜索驱动的心电图心律失常分类
summary: 在PhysioNet Challenge 2021共88,253份心电图上，用可微分架构搜索优化模型进行心律失常分类。
key_points: 用可微分架构搜索优化AutoFormer结构
数据为PC21三洲来源88,253份心电图
调优输入块大小、类别权重与损失函数
reason: 同行评审、大样本公开数据集，但为回顾性、无独立外部验证，属值得一看档。
abstract: [PloS one] Cardiovascular disease is the leading cause of death worldwide. Sudden cardiac death (SCD) accounts for roughly 50% of all cardiac deaths. The electrocardiogram (ECG) is widely used for diagnosing cardiac disease. However, the complexity of interpretation limits the ECG's efficacy. Modern deep learning methods can assist clinicians in diagnosis. We applied Neural Architecture Search (NAS) to identify optimal deep learning architectures for classifying cardiac arrhythmias with ECGs. We applied the Differentiable Architecture Search strategy to an AutoFormer search and trained, validated, and tested the resulting model on the PhysioNet Challenge 2021 (PC21) dataset (n = 88,253 from three continents). We optimised hyperparameters on the NAS output, exploring input patch size, class weighting, and loss function. The PC21 metric and the area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC) are the performance metrics. The NAS converged towards minimal architectural configurations (embedding dimension: 384, depth: 4, self-attention heads: 4, MLP ratio: 1) with a validation and test PC21 metric of 0.66 (PC21 winner: 0.63). The NAS-created network achieved an AUROC of 0.97 and a PC21 metric of 0.72 during testing (PC21 winner: 0.69). We tested the PC21 winner architecture (1D-convolutional neural network with attention mechanism) without the attention mechanism and with the NAS-suggested architecture of 4 self-attention heads (instead of 8). The architecture without the attention mechanism performed similarly to the one with 8 self-attention heads (AUROC: 0.90, PC21 metric: 0.69). The architecture with 4 self-attention heads scored an AUROC of 0.91 and improved the PC21 metric to 0.71. The attention mechanism visualisation for two SCD-related arrhythmias (premature ventricular contractions and prolonged QT-interval) showed more clinically relevant attention for the 4-self-attention-head architectures. We interpret architectural simplicity as driving performance in arrhythmia classification. The self-attention mechanism can autonomously abstract clinical representations, simplifying clinical deployment by eliminating the need for an explicit feature-extraction pipeline.
zh_abstract: [PloS one] 心血管疾病是全球主要死因。心源性猝死（SCD）约占所有心脏性死亡的 50%。心电图（ECG）广泛用于诊断心脏疾病。然而，解读的复杂性限制了 ECG 的效力。现代深度学习方法可辅助临床医生诊断。我们应用神经架构搜索（NAS）来识别用于通过 ECG 对心律失常进行分类的最佳深度学习架构。我们将可微架构搜索策略应用于 AutoFormer 搜索，并在 PhysioNet Challenge 2021（PC21）数据集（n = 88,253，来自三大洲）上训练、验证和测试所得模型。我们在 NAS 输出上优化超参数，探索输入 patch 大小、类别加权和损失函数。PC21 指标和受试者工作特征曲线下面积（AUROC）是性能指标。NAS 收敛到最小架构配置（嵌入维度：384，深度：4，自注意力头数：4，MLP 比例：1），验证和测试 PC21 指标为 0.66（PC21 冠军：0.63）。NAS 创建的测试期间网络达到 AUROC 0.97 和 PC21 指标 0.72（PC21 冠军：0.69）。我们测试了 PC21 冠军架构（带注意力机制的一维卷积神经网络）去掉注意力机制的版本，以及采用 NAS 建议的 4 个自注意力头（而非 8 个）的架构。去掉注意力机制的架构与具有 8 个自注意力头的架构表现相似（AUROC：0.90，PC21 指标：0.69）。具有 4 个自注意力头的架构得分为 AUROC 0.91，并将 PC21 指标提高到 0.71。对两种与 SCD 相关的心律失常（室性早搏和 QT 间期延长）的注意力机制可视化显示，4 个自注意力头架构具有更具临床相关性的注意力。我们将架构简洁性解释为心律失常分类性能的驱动因素。自注意力机制能够自主抽象临床表征，通过消除对显式特征提取流程的需求来简化临床部署。

title: Artificial Intelligence-Assisted Detection and Characterization of Colorectal Polyps during Colonoscopy: Evidence and Future Perspectives.

summary: 综述梳理结肠镜AI（CADe）从回顾性图像验证走向实时随机试验与Meta分析的证据，并讨论息肉表征与指南前景。

abstract: [Gut and liver] Colonoscopy is central to colorectal cancer prevention because it enables early detection and removal of premalignant lesions. However, lesions can still be missed, and endoscopic differentiation of neoplastic from nonneoplastic polyps remains variable, particularly for diminutive lesions. The potential of artificial intelligence (AI) as a supportive technology for improving both polyp detection and characterization during colonoscopy has therefore been investigated. Since early studies of convolutional neural network-based computer-aided detection (CADe), the focus has shifted from retrospective image-based validation to real-time randomized trials, meta-analyses, and clinical guideline discussions. Accumulating evidence suggests that CADe improves surrogate detection outcomes, including the adenoma detection rate (ADR), polyp detection rate, adenomas per colonoscopy, and adenoma miss rate. Although a higher ADR is associated with a lower risk of postcolonoscopy colorectal cancer, it remains unknown whether the incremental improvement in the ADR achieved by CADe translates into lower postcolonoscopy colorectal cancer incidence or colorectal cancer-related mortality. Recent multicenter data further support the effectiveness of real-time CADe systems in improving detection-related outcomes, while also indicating that benefit varies with lesion characteristics and user experience. In parallel, computer-aided diagnosis (CADx) has been developed to assist the optical characterization of colorectal polyps, particularly for diminutive lesions and potential resect-and-discard or diagnose-and-leave strategies. CADx systems using white-light imaging and structured high-confidence diagnostic rules show promise, but the clinical implementation of CADx remains less mature than that of CADe. This review summarizes current evidence for AI-assisted polyp detection and characterization and discusses limitations and future directions for integrating CADe and CADx into human-centered colonoscopy practices.
zh_abstract: 【综述】结肠镜检查是结直肠癌预防的核心，因为它能够早期发现并切除癌前病变。然而，病变仍可能被漏诊，且内镜下区分肿瘤性与非肿瘤性息肉仍存在差异，尤其是对于微小病变。因此，人们研究了人工智能（AI）作为支持技术改善结肠镜检查中息肉检测和表征的潜力。自早期基于卷积神经网络的计算机辅助检测（CADe）研究以来，重点已从回顾性基于图像的验证转向实时随机试验、荟萃分析和临床指南讨论。不断积累的证据表明，CADe改善替代检测结局，包括腺瘤检出率（ADR）、息肉检出率、每次结肠镜检查的腺瘤数和腺瘤漏诊率。尽管较高的ADR与较低的结肠镜检查后结直肠癌风险相关，但CADe实现的ADR增量改善是否转化为结肠镜检查后结直肠癌发病率或结直肠癌相关死亡率的降低仍未知。近期多中心数据进一步支持实时CADe系统在改善检测相关结局方面的有效性，同时也表明获益随病变特征和操作者经验而变化。与此同时，计算机辅助诊断（CADx）已被开发用于辅助结直肠息肉的光学表征，尤其是微小病变以及潜在的切除并丢弃或诊断并留置策略。使用白光成像和结构化高置信度诊断规则的CADx系统显示出前景，但CADx的临床实施仍不如CADe成熟。本综述总结AI辅助息肉检测和表征的当前证据，并讨论将CADe和CADx整合到以人为本的结肠镜检查实践中的局限性和未来方向。

title: MultiMHC: a multiscale learning framework integrating sequence and residue contact topology for peptide-MHC binding prediction.
zh_title: MultiMHC：融合序列与残基接触拓扑的pMHC结合预测
summary: 提出多尺度深度学习框架，结合序列与残基接触拓扑信息预测肽-MHC结合，用于抗原呈递与T细胞表位识别。

abstract: [Briefings in bioinformatics] Accurate prediction of peptide-major histocompatibility complex (pMHC) binding is central to understanding antigen presentation and identifying T-cell epitopes in cancer immunotherapy. Although recent methods have achieved notable progress, most approaches rely predominantly on sequence-based features and only partially capture structural determinants of pMHC recognition. In this study, we present MultiMHC, a multiscale deep learning framework that integrates complementary sequential and biologically-informed residue contact topology for pMHC binding prediction. MultiMHC combines a recurrent neural network to model global sequence context with a graph-based representation to encode residue contact patterns derived from known pMHC binding interfaces. Features from these two pathways are subsequently fused to generate binding predictions across peptides of varying lengths. Benchmark evaluations show that MultiMHC achieves performance comparable to existing state-of-the-art methods, with particularly strong performance in ranking-based assessments. Moreover, evaluation on the Tumor Neoantigen Selection Alliance dataset showed that MultiMHC binding scores can enrich experimentally validated T-cell epitopes among top-ranked candidates, supporting its potential utility as an upstream binding-based filtering step in neoantigen discovery workflows. Together, these results highlight the value of incorporating residue interaction patterns and lightweight structural information into pMHC modeling and establish MultiMHC as a robust and extensive framework for antigen presentation analysis.
zh_abstract: [Briefings in bioinformatics] 准确预测肽-主要组织相容性复合体（pMHC）结合对于理解抗原呈递以及在癌症免疫治疗中识别 T 细胞表位至关重要。尽管近期方法已取得显著进展，但大多数方法主要依赖基于序列的特征，仅部分捕捉 pMHC 识别的结构决定因素。在本研究中，我们提出 MultiMHC，这是一种多尺度深度学习框架，整合互补的序列信息和生物学信息指导的残基接触拓扑用于 pMHC 结合预测。MultiMHC 将用于建模全局序列上下文的循环神经网络与用于编码源自已知 pMHC 结合界面的残基接触模式的基于图的表示相结合。随后融合这两条通路的特征，以对不同长度肽段生成结合预测。基准评估显示，MultiMHC 达到与现有最先进方法相当的性能，在基于排序的评估中表现尤其强。此外，在 Tumor Neoantigen Selection Alliance 数据集上的评估显示，MultiMHC 结合评分可在排名靠前的候选物中富集经实验验证的 T 细胞表位，支持其作为新抗原发现流程中上游基于结合的过滤步骤的潜在用途。总之，这些结果凸显了将残基相互作用模式和轻量结构信息纳入 pMHC 建模的价值，并确立 MultiMHC 作为抗原呈递分析的稳健且广泛的框架。

title: SECNet: Differentiable Mask-Driven Spatiotemporal Learning for Video-Based Spontaneous Echo Contrast Severity Detection.
source: PubMed · IEEE journal of biomedical and health informatics
zh_title: SECNet：TEE视频自发性回声对比自动检测
summary: 提出端到端深度学习框架SECNet，用于经食管超声心动图视频中自发性回声对比（SEC）的自动检测与严重程度分级。
key_points: 感兴趣区分割模块定位易发结构并抑制噪声
时空模块捕捉SEC动态与空间分布

abstract: [IEEE journal of biomedical and health informatics] Spontaneous Echo Contrast (SEC), characterized by smoke-like dynamic echogenicity in trans esophageal echocardiography (TEE), serves as a critical imaging biomarker for assessing thromboembolic risk. However, current diagnostic approaches depend on manual interpretation or regression-based algorithms, which are labor-intensive, prone to inconsistency, and limited in generalizability. To address these challenges, we propose SECNet, an end-to-end deep learning framework for auto mated SEC detection in TEE videos. SECNet incorporates two key components: (1) a region-of-interest segmentation module that accurately localizes SEC-prone cardiac structures while suppressing surrounding noise; and (2) a spa tiotemporal feature extraction module that captures both temporal dynamics and spatial distribution of SEC. These modules are linked through a novel differentiable mask guided bridging mechanism that enables joint optimization of localization and representation learning. Trained on a clinical dataset of 1,106 annotated TEE videos, SECNet achieves 93.7% accuracy and a 90.0% F1-score, outper forming the compared methods by 3.1-23.3 percentage points in accuracy. An auxiliary experiment on EchoNet Dynamic further demonstrates the applicability of the architecture to a related echocardiographic video-analysis task. This study supports standardized and reproducible SEC assessment to assist thromboembolic risk evaluation in clinical workflows.
zh_abstract: 自发性回声对比（Spontaneous Echo Contrast, SEC）以经食管超声心动图（transesophageal echocardiography, TEE）中的烟雾样动态回声为特征，是评估血栓栓塞风险的关键影像学生物标志物。然而，当前诊断方法依赖人工判读或基于回归的算法，这些方法劳动强度大、易出现不一致且泛化性有限。为应对这些挑战，我们提出SECNet，一种用于TEE视频中自动化SEC检测的端到端深度学习框架。SECNet包含两个关键组件：（1）感兴趣区分割模块，可准确定位易发生SEC的心脏结构，同时抑制周围噪声；（2）时空特征提取模块，可捕捉SEC的时间动态和空间分布。这些模块通过一种新颖的可微掩膜引导桥接机制连接，从而实现定位与表征学习的联合优化。在包含1,106个标注TEE视频的临床数据集上训练，SECNet达到93.7%的准确率和90.0%的F1分数，在准确率上比对比方法高出3.1-23.3个百分点。在EchoNet Dynamic上的辅助实验进一步证明该架构适用于相关的超声心动图视频分析任务。本研究支持标准化和可重复的SEC评估，以辅助临床工作流程中的血栓栓塞风险评估。

abstract: [PLoS computational biology] The construction of accurate enzyme-constrained genome-scale models (ecGEMs) remains a critical challenge in systems biology, limited by sparse kinetic data and the need for biologically meaningful representations. This work presents an integrated framework combining CPI-Pred, a deep learning model to predict kinetic parameters (kcat) from sequence and compound embeddings, with kinGEMs, a pipeline to incorporate these uncertainty-aware parameters into ecGEMs for metabolic optimization. By leveraging representations at multiple scales, the approach captures sequence, structure, and kinetic data to enhance model generalizability and accuracy. Rigorous benchmarking demonstrates the framework's capability to predict growth rates and fluxes that are consistent with experimental observations and measured proteome fractions, reduce median flux variability by several folds, and yield better-constrained metabolic models by explicitly accounting for the uncertainty inherent in ML-predicted kinetic parameters. kinGEMs successfully generated ecGEMs for 93 models spanning a phylogenetically diverse set of organisms including Gram-negative and Gram-positive bacteria, mycobacteria, parasitic protists, fungi, and mammalian cell lines. These innovations breakdown the barrier to application of ecGEMs to non-model organisms and open new avenues for metabolic engineering and synthetic biology in more industrially relevant hosts.
zh_abstract: 构建准确的酶约束基因组尺度模型（enzyme-constrained genome-scale models, ecGEMs）仍是系统生物学中的关键挑战，受限于稀疏的动力学数据以及对具有生物学意义的表征的需求。本工作提出一个集成框架，将CPI-Pred（一种从序列和化合物嵌入预测动力学参数（kcat）的深度学习模型）与kinGEMs（一种将这些不确定性感知参数纳入ecGEMs以进行代谢优化的流程）相结合。通过利用多尺度表征，该方法捕获序列、结构和动力学数据，以增强模型的泛化性和准确性。严格的基准测试表明，该框架能够预测与实验观察和实测蛋白质组分数一致的生长速率和通量，将通量变异性的中位数降低数倍，并通过明确考虑机器学习预测的动力学参数中固有的不确定性，产生约束更好的代谢模型。kinGEMs成功为93个模型生成了ecGEMs，涵盖系统发育多样的一组生物，包括革兰阴性菌和革兰阳性菌、分枝杆菌、寄生性原生生物、真菌和哺乳动物细胞系。这些创新打破了将ecGEMs应用于非模式生物的障碍，并为在更具工业相关性的宿主中进行代谢工程和合成生物学开辟了新途径。

abstract: [Journal of the American Geriatrics Society] Delirium affects up to one-third of hospitalized older adults and is associated with adverse outcomes. Despite its clinical importance and the availability of validated screening tools, current care gaps extend beyond under-recognition to inconsistent risk stratification, workforce constraints, documentation burden, fragmented intervention delivery, and practical challenges with monitoring of response. We review how artificial intelligence (AI) could bridge these gaps and distinguish model development and validation, real-world clinical implementation, and emerging concepts in delirium care. Prediction models leveraging multimodal health record data, including structured variables and unstructured clinical notes, report good discrimination for delirium risk stratification, but only a few models have been integrated into clinical practice. A live multimodal machine learning model increased targeted delirium detection, yet a pre-post comparative study found a longer length of stay; improved recognition alone therefore does not equate with improved outcomes. Natural language processing, large language models, computer vision, ambient sensing, and wearable technologies enable more continuous, objective, and less labor-intensive assessment compared with traditional screening methods, but evidence remains limited with concerns about false positives and generalizability. AI-supported delirium management through reinforcement learning and digital twins is currently largely conceptual. Responsible AI adoption requires a clearly defined intended use, external validation, action pathways, equitable performance, privacy and security, consent and transparency, clinician oversight, patient preferences, and post-deployment monitoring. AI is most defensible as an adjunct that connects evidence-based delirium care to reliable execution rather than as a replacement for clinical assessment. Prospective comparative studies should evaluate patient outcomes, resource use, and balancing measures.
zh_abstract: [Journal of the American Geriatrics Society] 谵妄影响多达三分之一的住院老年人，并与不良结局相关。尽管其具有临床重要性且已有经过验证的筛查工具，当前的照护差距不仅限于识别不足，还包括风险分层不一致、人力限制、文档负担、干预提供碎片化以及监测反应方面的实际挑战。我们综述人工智能（AI）如何弥合这些差距，并区分模型开发与验证、真实世界临床实施以及谵妄照护中的新兴概念。利用多模态健康记录数据（包括结构化变量和非结构化临床笔记）的预测模型报告了对谵妄风险分层的良好区分度，但只有少数模型已整合到临床实践中。一个实时多模态机器学习模型提高了靶向谵妄检测，然而一项前后比较研究发现住院时间更长；因此，仅改善识别并不等同于改善结局。与传统的筛查方法相比，自然语言处理、大语言模型、计算机视觉、环境感知和可穿戴技术能够实现更连续、客观且劳动强度更低的评估，但证据仍然有限，且存在对假阳性和可推广性的担忧。通过强化学习和数字孪生进行的 AI 支持谵妄管理目前在很大程度上仍处于概念阶段。负责任地采用 AI 需要明确定义预期用途、外部验证、行动路径、公平性能、隐私与安全、知情同意与透明度、临床医生监督、患者偏好以及部署后监测。AI 最可辩护的定位是作为一种辅助手段，将循证谵妄照护与可靠执行连接起来，而不是替代临床评估。前瞻性比较研究应评估患者结局、资源使用和平衡指标。

abstract: [iScience] Biomimetic nicotinamide cofactors, such as nicotinamide mononucleotide (NMNH), can substantially reduce synthesis costs compared with natural cofactors like nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide phosphate (NADPH). However, natural enzymes generally exhibit poor activity with these alternative cofactors. Existing engineering approaches, including directed evolution and rational design, remain limited by experimental uncertainty or computational complexity. Here, we developed HelixWings, an artificial intelligence (AI)-driven screening platform that integrates conformational dynamics analysis with static microenvironment analysis to identify enzyme variants compatible with biomimetic cofactors. Applied to P450BM3, a widely used biocatalyst for chiral synthesis and pharmaceutical precursor production, HelixWings identified a variant with a 404% improvement in catalytic efficiency toward cytochrome c under NMNH-supported conditions. The platform was further validated with CYP116B46, achieving a 217% improvement in NMNH utilization efficiency. HelixWings reduced screening time by 23-fold compared with rational design.
zh_abstract: 仿生烟酰胺辅因子，如烟酰胺单核苷酸（nicotinamide mononucleotide, NMNH），与天然辅因子如烟酰胺腺嘌呤二核苷酸磷酸（nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide phosphate, NADPH）相比，可大幅降低合成成本。然而，天然酶通常对这些替代辅因子表现出较差活性。现有工程方法，包括定向进化和理性设计，仍受实验不确定性或计算复杂性限制。在此，我们开发了HelixWings，一个由人工智能（artificial intelligence, AI）驱动的筛选平台，将构象动力学分析与静态微环境分析相结合，以识别与仿生辅因子兼容的酶变体。应用于P450BM3——一种广泛用于手性合成和药物前体生产的生物催化剂——HelixWings鉴定出一个变体，在NMNH支持条件下对细胞色素c的催化效率提高404%。该平台进一步在CYP116B46上得到验证，NMNH利用效率提高217%。与理性设计相比，HelixWings将筛选时间缩短了23倍。

abstract: [iScience] Accurate discrimination of benign and malignant breast lesions is essential for early diagnosis, yet remains challenging due to lesion heterogeneity and interobserver variability in ultrasound assessment. We developed a deep learning (DL) framework integrating dual inverted bottleneck blocks (Dual-IB), adaptive hierarchical feature fusion, and knowledge distillation (KD) for breast ultrasound lesion classification. The model was trained and evaluated on public datasets and validated on an independent external cohort to assess its generalizability. Results demonstrated superior performance compared with baseline methods and resident radiologists, while maintaining robust performance across diverse datasets and imaging conditions. On the external validation dataset, the model achieved the best performance, with an accuracy (Acc) of 92.64% and an F1-score of 92.37%. Furthermore, class activation mapping (CAM) visualizations revealed focused and anatomically plausible attention patterns within lesion regions, aiding interpretation and suggesting its potential to assist in breast ultrasound lesion classification.
zh_abstract: [iScience] 准确区分乳腺良性与恶性病变对于早期诊断至关重要，但由于病变异质性以及超声评估中的观察者间变异性，仍具挑战性。我们开发了一种深度学习（DL）框架，整合双倒置瓶颈模块（dual inverted bottleneck blocks, Dual-IB）、自适应层次特征融合和知识蒸馏（knowledge distillation, KD），用于乳腺超声病变分类。该模型在公共数据集上训练和评估，并在独立外部队列上验证，以评估其泛化能力。结果显示，与基线方法和住院放射科医师相比具有更优性能，同时在多样数据集和成像条件下保持稳健性能。在外部验证数据集上，模型取得最佳性能，准确率（Acc）为92.64%，F1分数为92.37%。此外，类激活映射（class activation mapping, CAM）可视化显示病变区域内聚焦且解剖学上合理的注意力模式，有助于解释，并表明其辅助乳腺超声病变分类的潜力。

abstract: Using electronic health record (EHR) data to answer clinical research questions is challenging. It requires understanding the research question, finding relevant information across different sources, and combining that information to produce meaningful results. We developed an agentic large language model (LLM) pipeline that decomposes investigator-authored requests into source-specific tasks, generates and executes SQL on EHR, integrates structured and unstructured EHR evidence, and applies study-specific clinical note adjudication. We evaluated this workflow against data analyst-identified cohorts across 50 pediatric orthopedic clinical data query requests. Of these, 43 were included in manual-review-adjusted performance analyses. The median adjusted positive predictive value, sensitivity among patients identified by either approach, and corresponding F1 score were 0.93 (95% CI, 0.88-0.98), 0.92 (95% CI, 0.90-0.95) and 0.90 (95% CI, 0.87-0.94), respectively. These findings support the feasibility of translating natural-language research intent into executable, autonomous multi-stage EHR workflows.
zh_abstract: 使用电子健康记录（EHR）数据回答临床研究问题具有挑战性。它需要理解研究问题、在不同来源中查找相关信息，并整合这些信息以产生有意义的结果。我们开发了一种智能体大语言模型（LLM）流水线，可将研究者撰写的请求分解为针对特定来源的任务，在 EHR 上生成并执行 SQL，整合结构化与非结构化 EHR 证据，并应用研究特定的临床笔记裁定。我们在 50 项儿科骨科临床数据查询请求中，将该工作流与数据分析师识别出的队列进行对照评估。其中 43 项纳入经人工复核调整的性能分析。调整后的阳性预测值中位数、在任一方法识别出的患者中的敏感性，以及相应的 F1 分数分别为 0.93（95% CI，0.88-0.98）、0.92（95% CI，0.90-0.95）和 0.90（95% CI，0.87-0.94）。这些发现支持将自然语言研究意图转化为可执行、自主的多阶段 EHR 工作流程的可行性。

title: MedGraph: Maintaining Patient State with Graph Memory for Long-Term Medical Dialogue

summary: 针对状态过时、人物混淆与安全事实缺失三类记忆错误，提出图记忆MedGraph，并在MedMemoryBench上评测。
key_points: 从每次会话抽取带日期事实并归属到个人
将用药、诊断、测量链接为保留既往状态的链
检索按问题时间点读取整链并附原文对话
reason: 预印本新方法与自建基准，但缺少外部临床验证
abstract: LLM-based medical assistants that follow a patient across visits need a memory that keeps the patient's clinical state correct as it changes. We examine the errors of five memory systems on longitudinal medical dialogue and find three recurring causes: the retrieved evidence gives an outdated state, includes another person's health facts, or lacks a safety fact the answer depends on. We present MedGraph, a graph memory built for these three cases. Construction extracts dated facts from each session, attributes each fact to the person it describes, and links medication, diagnosis, and measurement records into chains that keep earlier states. Retrieval ranks the patient's chains as units, reads each chain at the time the question asks about, and adds the original dialogue text; a patient profile lists every recorded safety fact with every question. On MedMemoryBench, MedGraph has the highest overall accuracy with both a GPT and a Qwen backbone, 10.5 and 10.4 points above the strongest of five baselines, with efficient memory construction and answering in the GPT setting.
zh_abstract: 跟随患者跨就诊过程的基于 LLM 的医疗助手需要一种记忆，能在患者临床状态变化时保持其正确。我们考察了五种记忆系统在纵向医学对话中的错误，并发现三类反复出现的原因：检索到的证据给出过时状态、包含他人的健康事实，或缺少答案所依赖的安全性事实。我们提出 MedGraph，一种为这三类情况构建的图记忆。其构建过程从每次会话中提取带日期的事实，将每条事实归属于其所描述的人，并将药物、诊断和测量记录链接成保留既往状态的链。检索以患者的链为单位进行排序，在问题所询问的时间点读取每条链，并加入原始对话文本；患者档案随每个问题列出所有已记录的安全性事实。在 MedMemoryBench 上，MedGraph 在 GPT 和 Qwen 骨干模型下均取得最高总体准确率，分别比五个基线中最强者高 10.5 和 10.4 个百分点，并在 GPT 设置下具有高效的记忆构建和回答。

title: A Cross-Dataset Audit of Discrimination and Conformal Prediction Coverage in Keystroke-Based Parkinson's Disease Classi cation
zh_title: 击键动态识别帕金森的跨数据集审计
summary: 预印本在4个公开数据集475人中检验击键分类器的跨数据集判别力与保形预测覆盖率。

abstract: Typing dynamics are being investigated as a digital behavioral marker for Parkinson's disease (PD), but the cross-dataset reliability of typing-based classi ers remains uncertain. We evaluated four public datasets (475 par ticipants; 270 with PD and 205 controls) across 12 transfer directions using split conformal prediction targeting 90% marginal coverage. In all three pri mary directions, coverage was below the 0.90 target and the one-sided tests remained signi cant after Holm correction: 0.598 (95% CI, 0.4830.704) for Tappy[->]MIT, 0.850 (0.7880.899) for MIT[->]Tappy, and 0.732 (0.6840.777) for clinical[->]self-reported transfer. Discrimination and coverage did not con sistently change together: LightGBM had lower AUC than logistic regression in all 12 directions but higher coverage in 11, with larger prediction sets. Class-conditional coverage varied by target cohort: PD-conditional cover age was 0.214 for Tappy[->]MIT, whereas healthy-control coverage was 0.700 for MIT[->]Tappy and 0.627 for clinical[->]self-reported transfer. Recalibration with 9 and 18 labeled target participants raised the lower condence bound above 0.80 in the latter two directions; in Tappy[->]MIT, it remained below 0.80 even with 25 labels. Weighted conformal prediction yielded coverage of 0.9181.000 without target labels but returned the full label set for 86% 100% of participants. Stress tests did not reproduce the observed coverage patterns, and black-box shift estimation did not support pure label shift as the dominant explanation for Tappy[->]MIT. Evaluating typing dynamics as a digital marker for PD requires cross-dataset assessment of discrimination, marginal and class-conditional coverage, and recovery costs. Clinical screen ing utility has not been established.
zh_abstract: 打字动态正被研究作为帕金森病（PD）的数字行为标志物，但基于打字的分类器的跨数据集可靠性仍不确定。我们评估了四个公共数据集（475名参与者；270例PD和205例对照），使用分裂共形预测（split conformal prediction）以90%边际覆盖率为目标，在12个迁移方向上进行分析。在所有三个主要方向上，覆盖率均低于0.90目标，且单侧检验在Holm校正后仍显著：Tappy→MIT为0.598（95% CI，0.483–0.704），MIT→Tappy为0.850（0.788–0.899），临床→自我报告迁移为0.732（0.684–0.777）。判别能力与覆盖率并未一致地同向变化：LightGBM在所有12个方向上的AUC均低于逻辑回归，但在11个方向上覆盖率更高，且预测集更大。类别条件覆盖率因目标队列而异：Tappy→MIT的PD条件覆盖率为0.214，而MIT→Tappy的健康对照覆盖率为0.700，临床→自我报告迁移为0.627。使用9名和18名有标签的目标参与者进行重校准，在后两个方向上使置信下界升至0.80以上；在Tappy→MIT中，即使使用25个标签，其仍低于0.80。加权共形预测在无目标标签时产生的覆盖率为0.918–1.000，但对86%–100%的参与者返回了完整标签集。压力测试未能重现观察到的覆盖率模式，黑箱偏移估计也不支持纯标签偏移是Tappy→MIT的主要解释。将打字动态作为PD数字标志物进行评估，需要跨数据集评估判别能力、边际覆盖率与类别条件覆盖率以及恢复代价。其临床筛查效用尚未确立。

abstract: Current medical benchmarks typically break down clinical competence into isolated factual questions, single-image tasks, or static case vignettes. These tests score individual answers, but reveal less about whether a model can integrate subspecialty knowledge with multimodal evidence and track a patient's condition throughout a course of care. To close this gap, we introduce NPCBench, a clinical apprenticeship benchmark for nasopharyngeal carcinoma (NPC). NPCBench mirrors specialist training, from guideline and foundational knowledge to case planning, longitudinal review, CarePath integration, and open-ended consultation. It contains 4,777 component and consultation items and a 100-patient CarePath cohort with 417 scored diagnostic and care tasks. The episode-level evaluation tests whether diagnostic and care answers are jointly correct within a care pathway. By linking stepwise tasks to patient-level care trajectories, NPCBench evaluates whether models ground decisions in visual evidence, interpret changes in patient state, and meet clinical requirements in consultation. Across 30 evaluated models, we observe a composition gap: strong performance on individual tasks does not ensure jointly correct diagnostic and care answers for the same patient. Among 21 multimodal models, strict CarePath success reaches at most 23%. Paired controls and physician calibration further examine evidence grounding, longitudinal revision, and consultation judging. Overall, NPCBench broadens the evaluation of medical artificial intelligence beyond static question-answering paradigms to an apprenticeship-oriented assessment of clinical workflows, thereby offering a testbed for evidence-based and temporally coherent reasoning in oncology care.
zh_abstract: 当前的医学基准通常将临床能力拆解为孤立的事实性问题、单图像任务或静态病例简介。这些测试对单个答案评分，但较少揭示模型是否能够将亚专科知识与多模态证据整合，并在整个照护过程中追踪患者病情。为弥合这一差距，我们推出 NPCBench，一个针对鼻咽癌（NPC）的临床学徒制基准。NPCBench 模拟专科培训，从指南和基础知识到病例规划、纵向审查、CarePath 整合以及开放式咨询。它包含 4,777 个组成部分和咨询条目，以及一个 100 名患者的 CarePath 队列，其中有 417 个计分的诊断和照护任务。片段级评估测试诊断和照护答案在一条照护路径内是否共同正确。通过将分步任务与患者层面的照护轨迹相关联，NPCBench 评估模型是否将决策建立在视觉证据上、解释患者状态的变化，并在咨询中满足临床要求。在 30 个被评估模型中，我们观察到一种组合性差距：在单个任务上的强劲表现并不能确保对同一患者给出共同正确的诊断和照护答案。在 21 个多模态模型中，严格的 CarePath 成功率最高达到 23%。配对对照和医生校准进一步考察证据基础、纵向修正和咨询评判。总体而言，NPCBench 将医学人工智能的评估从静态问答范式拓展到面向学徒制的临床工作流程评估，从而为肿瘤照护中基于证据且时间连贯的推理提供一个测试平台。

abstract: Cell-type identification in spatial transcriptomics often relies on cell segmentation, which can introduce inaccuracies in cell boundaries and transcript assignment. Segmentation-free or cell-free methods have been developed to completely avoid cell segmentation, but inaccurate cell typing hinder accurate downstream analysis. Here, we introduce SSAF-T, a segmentation-free agentic framework that identifies cell types directly from spatial gene expression without predefined reference datasets. For the reference-free cell typing, SSAF-T incorporates CeLLMan, which employs expert-level agents for each organ to annotate cell types using a literature-grounded knowledge graph. We benchmark SSAF-T on both array-based and imaging-based spatial transcriptomics datasets in terms of accuracy, reproducibility, and scalability. We further show that SSAF-T provides an accurate cell segmentation based on the segmentation-free mapping, which ensure compatibility to existing downstream analysis ecosystem, and eventually enable quantitative analysis at single-cell level.
zh_abstract: 空间转录组学中的细胞类型鉴定通常依赖细胞分割，而细胞分割可能在细胞边界和转录本分配方面引入不准确性。为完全避免细胞分割，已开发出无分割或无细胞方法，但不准确的细胞分型会阻碍准确的下游分析。在此，我们介绍 SSAF-T，一种无需细胞分割的智能体框架，可直接从空间基因表达中鉴定细胞类型，且无需预定义参考数据集。为实现无参考细胞分型，SSAF-T 整合了 CeLLMan，后者为每个器官采用专家级智能体，利用基于文献的知识图谱注释细胞类型。我们在基于微阵列和基于成像的空间转录组数据集上，从准确性、可重复性和可扩展性方面对 SSAF-T 进行基准测试。我们进一步表明，SSAF-T 基于无分割映射提供准确的细胞分割，这确保与现有下游分析生态兼容，并最终实现单细胞水平的定量分析。

abstract: [Early human development] Early identification of language development delays in preschool children enables timely intervention during critical developmental windows, yet existing screening tools rely on periodic snapshots that miss the dynamic, trajectory-based nature of language acquisition. This study presents a multimodal deep learning framework - a Bidirectional Long Short-Term Memory network with multi-head attention - for predicting individual language development trajectories from birth to 24 months using acoustic, linguistic, and behavioral feature streams collected in naturalistic early educational environments. Trained on 6349 longitudinal assessments from 847 children across three collection sites, the model achieves a mean absolute error of 4.2 score points, R2 = 0.93, and an AUC-ROC of 0.94 for language delay classification. Ablation experiments confirm that multimodal fusion outperforms any single modality, with linguistic features contributing the largest marginal gain. The model accurately identifies children with language delay risk at 12 months with 84% sensitivity and 92% specificity, outperforming standard clinical screening instruments on specificity while maintaining comparable sensitivity. Subgroup analyses confirm consistent performance across socioeconomic, bilingual, and gender-based subgroups. Feature importance analysis reveals that early acoustic features dominate prediction in the first six months, while linguistic and behavioral features grow in importance across development. Practical implementation guidelines are provided for deployment in preschool and early educational settings.
zh_abstract: [Early human development] 在学龄前儿童中早期识别语言发育迟缓，有助于在关键发育窗口期及时干预，但现有筛查工具依赖于周期性快照，无法捕捉语言习得的动态、基于轨迹的本质。本研究提出一种多模态深度学习框架——带多头注意力的双向长短期记忆网络（Bidirectional Long Short-Term Memory network with multi-head attention）——利用在自然情境早期教育环境中收集的声学、语言和行为特征流，预测从出生到24个月的个体语言发育轨迹。模型在来自三个采集点的847名儿童的6349次纵向评估上训练，平均绝对误差为4.2分，R2 = 0.93，语言迟缓分类的AUC-ROC为0.94。消融实验证实，多模态融合优于任何单一模态，其中语言特征贡献了最大的边际增益。该模型可在12个月时以84%的敏感度和92%的特异度准确识别有语言迟缓风险的儿童，在特异度上优于标准临床筛查工具，同时保持相当的敏感度。亚组分析证实，在不同社会经济、双语和性别亚组中性能一致。特征重要性分析显示，早期声学特征在最初六个月主导预测，而语言和行为特征在整个发育过程中重要性逐渐增加。本文提供了在学前和早期教育环境中部署的实用实施指南。

abstract: [Newly registered clinical trial, no results yet; sponsor: zhaoxiaohui; conditions: Cancer, Malignant Neoplasms, Radiotherapy; type: INTERVENTIONAL; phase: NA; enrollment: 62; status: NOT_YET_RECRUITING] Radiotherapy, a cornerstone of comprehensive cancer treatment, relies heavily on clinician expertise for target volume contouring and treatment planning. Consequently, clinical practice is often constrained by procedural bottlenecks, inter-observer variability, and prolonged iterative feedback cycles. Although current artificial intelligence (AI) models have demonstrated progress in automated contouring, key limitations persist, including insufficient integration of multimodal clinical text, a lack of closed-loop dosimetric feedback, and limited generalizability across complex cancer types. This study aims to develop and validate RATA (Radiotherapy Treatment Multi-Agent Assistant), a novel large model system powered by a collaborative multi-agent architecture. Driven by Large Language Model (LLM) decision engines, RATA processes pathological imaging, electronic health records (EHR), and multimodal medical data to construct a end-to-end, fully automated closed-loop pipeline encompassing "target contouring, plan design, dosimetric evaluation, and reflective refinement." Innovatively breaking through traditional unidirectional radiotherapy workflows, the system establishes a dosimetric feedback-driven adaptive iteration mechanism, leveraging dose distribution outcomes to guide multi-agent dynamic fine-tuning of target volumes, thereby mimicking the collaborative clinical logic between senior radiation oncologists and medical physicists. For validation, this study adopts a multi-center, three-stage clinical validation framework-comprising multi-center retrospective validation, human-AI collaborative efficacy assessment, and a prospective randomized controlled trial (RCT)-to comprehensively evaluate the system's performance in improving contouring precision, mitigating experience-dependent disparities across clinician seniority, and reducing total workflow processing time. Implementation of the RATA platform holds potential to eliminate redundant operational steps, enabling a minute-level "scan-to-treat" response. Furthermore, its natural language interaction interface optimizes human-AI collaboration and substantially reduces clinical workload. Overall, this study not only establishes a standardized, intelligent assistance paradigm for precision radiation oncology but also provides essential evidence-based support and technological foundations for the clinical translation of multimodal AI in complex cancer management.
zh_abstract: [新注册临床试验，尚无结果；申办者：zhaoxiaohui；疾病：癌症、恶性肿瘤、放疗；类型：INTERVENTIONAL；分期：NA；入组人数：62；状态：NOT_YET_RECRUITING] 放疗是综合癌症治疗的基石，在靶区勾画和治疗计划方面高度依赖临床医生的专业知识。因此，临床实践常受流程瓶颈、观察者间变异和延长的迭代反馈周期所限。尽管当前人工智能（AI）模型在自动勾画方面已取得进展，但关键局限仍然存在，包括多模态临床文本整合不足、缺乏闭环剂量学反馈，以及在复杂癌症类型间泛化性有限。本研究旨在开发并验证RATA（Radiotherapy Treatment Multi-Agent Assistant），一种由协作式多智能体架构驱动的新型大模型系统。由大语言模型（LLM）决策引擎驱动，RATA处理病理影像、电子健康记录（EHR）和多模态医学数据，以构建涵盖“靶区勾画、计划设计、剂量学评估和反思性优化”的端到端、全自动闭环流程。该系统创新性地突破传统单向放疗工作流，建立剂量学反馈驱动的自适应迭代机制，利用剂量分布结果指导多智能体对靶区进行动态微调，从而模拟资深放射肿瘤科医生与医学物理师之间的协作临床逻辑。为进行验证，本研究采用多中心、三阶段临床验证框架——包括多中心回顾性验证、人机协作疗效评估和前瞻性随机对照试验（RCT）——以全面评估该系统在提高勾画精度、减轻不同资历临床医生之间经验依赖差异以及减少总工作流处理时间方面的性能。RATA平台的实施有望消除冗余操作步骤，实现分钟级“扫描到治疗”响应。此外，其自然语言交互界面优化人机协作并大幅降低临床工作量。总体而言，本研究不仅为精准放射肿瘤学建立了标准化、智能化辅助范式，还为多模态AI在复杂癌症管理中的临床转化提供了必要的循证支持和技术基础。

abstract: [Journal of controlled release : official journal of the Controlled Release Society] The translation of nanomedicines remains constrained by persistent bottlenecks, including complex design parameters, unpredictable in vivo behavior, and low diagnostic accuracy. Artificial intelligence (AI), with its advanced data processing and learning algorithms, offers new solutions to these challenges by learning from heterogeneous data and supporting decision-making throughout nanomedicine development. This review summarizes the AI methods and modeling workflows relevant to nanomedicine and surveys their applications in rational nanomaterial design, prediction of in vivo fate and nano-bio interactions, theranostic imaging analysis, and formulation and manufacturing optimization. This review further discusses the main barriers that currently limit translation, which largely concern data, model reliability, and computational cost. Future progress will depend on better data resources, more generalizable and interpretable models, and closer integration of AI with experimental and mechanistic approaches. We believe that through these advances, AI-enabled nanomedicine will ultimately achieve more reliable and translatable outcomes.

abstract: [Frontiers in cardiovascular medicine] Minimally invasive surgery (MIS), including endovascular and robot-assisted procedures, is widely used for vascular pathologies but remains limited by technical complexity, cognitive workload, and postoperative complications. Artificial Intelligence (AI) may help address these challenges through predictive analysis, decision support, image analysis, and automation. A structured Google Scholar search was conducted from February 21, 2025, to January 1, 2026, and updated through September 2026. Peer-reviewed studies applying AI to vascular MIS were included, with additional targeted searches addressing clinical translation, deployment, regulation, and ethical considerations. Thirty primary studies were analyzed, including eight on machine learning, nine on deep learning, four on natural language processing, and nine on robotics or reinforcement learning. Machine learning supported risk stratification and outcome prediction, deep learning enabled imaging and segmentation applications, natural language processing facilitated clinical information extraction, and robotic systems supported navigation and procedural assistance. AI demonstrates substantial potential across the vascular MIS pathway, but broader clinical adoption requires stronger validation, prospective multicenter studies, standardized reporting, health-economic evaluation, and careful consideration of regulatory, liability, and accessibility challenges.
zh_abstract: [Frontiers in Cardiovascular Medicine] 微创手术（MIS），包括血管内和机器人辅助手术，广泛用于血管病变，但仍受技术复杂性、认知负荷和术后并发症的限制。人工智能（AI）可通过预测分析、决策支持、图像分析和自动化帮助应对这些挑战。于2025年2月21日至2026年1月1日进行了结构化 Google Scholar 检索，并更新至2026年9月。纳入将 AI 应用于血管 MIS 的同行评审研究，并进行了补充性针对性检索，涉及临床转化、部署、监管和伦理考量。分析了30项原始研究，包括8项机器学习、9项深度学习、4项自然语言处理和9项机器人或强化学习研究。机器学习支持风险分层和结局预测，深度学习实现影像和分割应用，自然语言处理促进临床信息提取，机器人系统支持导航和操作辅助。AI 在血管 MIS 全流程中显示出巨大潜力，但更广泛的临床采用需要更强验证、前瞻性多中心研究、标准化报告、卫生经济学评估，以及审慎考虑监管、责任和可及性挑战。

abstract: Neural organoids are three-dimensional stem cell-derived models widely used to study brain development and model disease. Brightfield imaging offers a non-invasive readout of their growth and morphology, and recent advances have made automated organoid segmentation from such images increasingly attainable. Yet existing tools largely leave morphological characterization, quality assessment, and comparisons between conditions to manual or ad hoc analysis. Here we present Organotchi, an open-source tool that integrates automated segmentation with longitudinal morphological analysis of neural organoids. Organotchi quantifies ten morphological features, including area, perimeter, and eccentricity, and tracks cystic structures over time, reports variability within and between batches, and flags outlier organoids and segmentation failures, supporting objective organoid characterization and enhancing downstream analysis. As a proof of concept, we apply Organotchi to disease modelling, pharmacological perturbation, and protocol optimization in neural organoids. One use case assesses drug response in breast cancer spheroids, demonstrating its use beyond its development domain.
zh_abstract: 神经类器官是三维干细胞衍生模型，广泛用于研究脑发育和模拟疾病。明场成像可对其生长和形态提供非侵入性读出，而近期进展使从此类图像进行自动类器官分割日益可行。然而，现有工具在很大程度上将形态学表征、质量评估和条件间比较留给人工或临时分析。在此我们提出 Organotchi，一种开源工具，将自动分割与神经类器官的纵向形态学分析相结合。Organotchi 量化十种形态学特征，包括面积、周长和偏心率，并随时间追踪囊性结构，报告批次内和批次间变异性，并标记离群类器官和分割失败，支持客观的类器官表征并增强下游分析。作为概念验证，我们将 Organotchi 应用于神经类器官的疾病建模、药物扰动和方案优化。一个用例评估乳腺癌球状体中的药物反应，证明其用途超出其开发领域。

abstract: Designing healthcare strategies requires anticipating their clinical and operational consequences before implementation, a task that often relies on health system simulation. Such a simulation necessitates modeling how patient states evolve and generate care demands. However, conventional approaches typically tailor compact state transitions to a single policy question and omit history-dependent dynamics, thus requiring the redefinition of states and transitions when there is a new question that entails different clinical information. We propose to learn a patient world model from longitudinal EHRs using a neural network to provide a shared clinical representation of patient trajectories that can serve simulation questions across scenarios. Taking ICU operations as an example, we train the model on MIMIC-IV, freeze it, and couple its time-queryable predictions to shared ICU calendars, resources, and queues via scenario-specific mappings, so that one model renders admission demand, care tasks, and discharge proposals across simulations evaluating ICU bed capacity, care dispatch, and post-ICU transfer capacity. Experiments show that our model matches Markov and semi-Markov comparators in aggregate occupancy and directional responses to capacity and dispatch policies. It also reproduces policy gains from replayed observed trajectories. For patients entering the same support state from different prior trajectories, the learned representation captures a 24-h recovery difference (-6.4 predicted versus -6.7 observed percentage points), a contrast missed by compact state models, which propagates into distinct simulated care demand, queue burden, and bed use. These results indicate that a learned world model of patient dynamics has the potential to replace question-specific state models, allowing new care policies to be evaluated by reconfiguring the scenario without model rebuilding.
zh_abstract: 设计医疗策略需要在实施前预判其临床和运营后果，这一任务通常依赖卫生系统仿真。此类仿真必须对患者状态如何演变并产生照护需求进行建模。然而，传统方法通常将紧凑的状态转移裁剪为针对单一政策问题，并忽略依赖历史的动态过程，因此当出现需要不同临床信息的新问题时，就需要重新定义状态和转移。我们提出使用神经网络从纵向电子健康记录（EHR）中学习患者世界模型，以提供患者轨迹的共享临床表征，从而可服务于跨场景的仿真问题。以 ICU 运营为例，我们在 MIMIC-IV 上训练模型，将其冻结，并通过场景特定映射将其可时间查询的预测与共享的 ICU 日历、资源和队列耦合，从而使一个模型在评估 ICU 床位容量、照护调度和 ICU 后转运能力的各项仿真中呈现入院需求、照护任务和出院建议。实验表明，我们的模型在总体占用率以及对容量和调度政策的定向响应方面与马尔可夫和半马尔可夫对照模型相匹配。它还能再现从回放观察轨迹中得到的政策收益。对于从不同既往轨迹进入同一支持状态的患者，学习到的表征捕捉到 24 小时恢复差异（预测为 -6.4 个百分点，观察为 -6.7 个百分点），这是紧凑状态模型遗漏的对比，并会传播为不同的模拟照护需求、队列负担和床位使用。这些结果表明，患者动态的学习世界模型有潜力替代问题特定的状态模型，从而可通过重新配置场景来评估新的照护政策，而无需重建模型。

title: LeadWeaver: Topology-Aware Masked-Lead Modeling for Robust 12-Lead ECG Diagnosis

summary: 预印本提出拓扑感知掩码导联建模，在PTB-XL及CPSC类设置下评估缺失或损坏导联的心电图诊断。

固定加学习的生理导联图耦合
采用掩码导联潜在补全而非波形合成

abstract: Clinical electrocardiography is organized as a structured set of correlated leads, yet most neural ECG classifiers assume that all twelve leads are present, correctly ordered, and acquired under the same device conditions at training and deployment. We propose LeadWeaver, a topology-aware ECG representation model designed for diagnosis under missing, corrupted, or device-shifted leads. LeadWeaver represents each lead as a temporal token stream, couples leads through a fixed-plus-learned physiological lead graph, and performs masked-lead latent completion rather than waveform synthesis. A reliability router estimates which observed leads should dominate each diagnostic decision, while a consistency objective aligns complete-lead and incomplete-lead predictions. We evaluate the model on PTB-XL and CPSC-style settings using complete-input diagnosis, arbitrary missing-lead subsets, lead corruption, cross-dataset transfer, calibration, and selective prediction. The central hypothesis is that robust ECG diagnosis requires explicitly modeling both inter-lead topology and uncertainty about unavailable evidence, rather than treating missing channels as zero-valued inputs.
zh_abstract: 临床心电图被组织为一组结构化的相关导联，然而大多数神经 ECG 分类器假设十二个导联均存在、顺序正确，并且在训练和部署时处于相同设备条件下采集。我们提出 LeadWeaver，一种拓扑感知的 ECG 表征模型，设计用于在导联缺失、损坏或设备偏移情况下进行诊断。LeadWeaver 将每个导联表示为时间 token 流，通过固定的加可学习的生理导联图耦合导联，并执行掩蔽导联的潜在补全而非波形合成。可靠性路由器估计哪些观察导联应在每个诊断决策中占主导，而一致性目标对齐完整导联和不完整导联的预测。我们在 PTB-XL 和 CPSC 风格设置中评估该模型，使用完整输入诊断、任意缺失导联子集、导联损坏、跨数据集迁移、校准和选择性预测。核心假设是，稳健的 ECG 诊断需要显式建模导联间拓扑结构以及对不可用证据的不确定性，而不是将缺失通道视为零值输入。

title: OraRefer: Segmentation-Guided Multi-Photograph Fusion for Oral Cancer Screening with Guaranteed Patient-Level Sensitivity

summary: 预印本提出分割引导的多照片融合口腔癌筛查模型，以阈值保证患者级敏感度。
key_points: 在714名患者3000张照片上评估
先分割定位病灶再融合同一患者多张照片与危险因素
推理无需标注，按患者而非单张照片做转诊决策

abstract: Oral cancer and the oral potentially malignant disorders (OPMD) that can precede it are visible on the oral mucosa, which makes smartphone photographs a promising tool for screening. Deep learning models for this task classify individual photographs. However, screening refers patients, not photographs: a patient is usually photographed several times, and the referral decision must miss no more than a set share of patients with disease. We propose OraRefer, a patient-level screening model that reads each photograph with a segmentation-guided foundation model that conditions its class decision on the predicted lesion, combines all photographs of a patient with risk factors, and refers through a threshold with a finite-sample sensitivity guarantee. The model localizes the mouth itself, so inference needs no annotation. On 3000 photographs of 714 patients, patient-level fusion reaches an AUROC of 0.919 and outperforms attention-based multiple-instance learning. At a 90% sensitivity target, OraRefer detects 95% of patients with OPMD or cancer and misses 3 of 61 patients with cancer, at a specificity of 0.610. Because the threshold is calibrated without retraining, each clinic can set its own guaranteed operating point on a local calibration sample.
zh_abstract: 口腔癌及其可能先于其出现的口腔潜在恶性疾患（OPMD）在口腔黏膜上可见，这使智能手机照片成为有前景的筛查工具。用于此任务的深度学习模型对单张照片进行分类。然而，筛查转诊的是患者而非照片：一名患者通常会被拍摄多次，且转诊决策漏诊的患病患者比例不得超过设定比例。我们提出OraRefer，一种患者级筛查模型，其使用分割引导的基础模型读取每张照片，该模型以预测病灶为条件作出类别决策，将一名患者的所有照片与风险因素结合，并通过具有有限样本敏感性保证的阈值进行转诊。该模型自身定位口腔，因此推理无需标注。在714名患者的3000张照片上，患者级融合达到0.919的AUROC，并优于基于注意力的多实例学习。在90%敏感性目标下，OraRefer检出95%的OPMD或癌症患者，并在特异性为0.610时漏诊61例癌症患者中的3例。由于阈值无需重新训练即可校准，每家诊所可在本地校准样本上设定自身有保证的工作点。

title: Hierarchical Temporal Transformer for Cancer Grade Prediction and Cross-Cancer Transfer Learning from Pathology Reports

summary: 预印本构建层级时序Transformer处理病理报告序列，用于肿瘤分级预测并测试跨癌种迁移。

abstract: Background: Language models for cancer reports usually read one document at a time and are tested on tumour types seen in training. Continuous-time sequence models address the first gap, but whether they use visit timing, not just order, is seldom tested. Methods: We developed the Hierarchical Temporal Transformer (HTT), which encodes reports with adapted BiomedBERT and reads the sequence with a cancer-type-conditioned temporal transformer. We evaluated it against best-possible AUROC ceilings on two synthetic benchmarks, one with the label stated in the text and one recoverable only from tumour sizes and visit intervals (ten seeds). Diagnostics led to an interval-aware time code (HTT-IA). On 4,786 TCGA pathology reports in 14 types, three types were withheld, and a text-only HTT was compared with a survival model. Results: On the phrase benchmark HTT reached AUROC 0.931 +/- 0.012 against 0.913 +/- 0.007 for a last-report baseline (+0.018, 95% CI -0.009 to +0.050); dates cannot raise the ceiling there. On the growth benchmark the initial time code scored 0.790, equal to a no-time model (0.787), whereas HTT-IA reached 0.843 (+0.053, 0.026 to 0.082) against ceilings of 0.894 without and 0.979 with dates. On unseen tumour types HTT reached 0.925 +/- 0.007, equal to in-distribution performance and to a single-report baseline. Text-only macro C-index was 0.592 (CALM 0.626-0.652). Conclusion: Cross-type transfer is carried by the pre-trained encoder. Visit timing is used only when the data make it identifiable and the time code is on a clinical scale. Ceilings, order-only ablations and re-dating probes are inexpensive checks for such models.
zh_abstract: 【背景】用于癌症报告的语言模型通常一次只读取一份文档，并在训练中见过的肿瘤类型上接受测试。连续时间序列模型弥补了第一个缺口，但它们是否利用就诊时间而不仅是顺序，鲜有被检验。【方法】我们开发了分层时间Transformer（Hierarchical Temporal Transformer, HTT），它用适配的BiomedBERT编码报告，并用癌症类型条件化的时间Transformer读取序列。我们在两个合成基准上评估其相对于最佳可能AUROC上限的表现，一个基准的标签在文本中陈述，另一个只能从肿瘤大小和就诊间隔中恢复（十个随机种子）。诊断分析促成了一个间隔感知的时间编码（HTT-IA）。在14种类型的4,786份TCGA病理报告中，三种类型被留出，并将纯文本HTT与生存模型进行比较。【结果】在短语基准上，HTT达到AUROC 0.931 +/- 0.012，而末次报告基线为0.913 +/- 0.007（+0.018，95% CI -0.009至+0.050）；在那里日期无法提高上限。在生长基准上，初始时间编码得分为0.790，与无时间模型（0.787）相同，而HTT-IA达到0.843（+0.053，0.026至0.082），对应的上限为无日期0.894和有日期0.979。在未见肿瘤类型上，HTT达到0.925 +/- 0.007，与分布内性能以及单报告基线相同。纯文本宏C-index为0.592（CALM 0.626-0.652）。【结论】跨类型迁移由预训练编码器承担。只有当数据使就诊时间可识别且时间编码处于临床尺度时，才会使用就诊时间。上限、仅顺序消融和重新标注日期探针是此类模型的廉价检查。

title: Benchmarking Large Language Models on Heterogeneous Cognitive and Biomedical Knowledge Graphs: The Role of Graph Grounding in Multi-Hop Reasoning and Hallucination Mitigation
zh_title: 异构生物医学知识图谱上的大模型多跳推理基准
summary: 预印本对GPT-5.1、Gemini 2.0 Pro、Llama 3、Qwen与BioGPT在五个知识图谱上做多层级查询评测，发现图谱接地可降低幻觉。
key_points: 覆盖DrugBank、NeuroSynth等五个知识图谱
通用模型多跳推理优于领域专用模型
查询越复杂性能下降，图谱接地降幻觉
reason: 预印本基准研究，方法有新意但无临床外部验证，属值得一看
abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used in biomedical and cognitive neuroscience, but their ability to reason reliably over heterogeneous knowledge graphs (KGs) remains unclear. We benchmark five LLMs (GPT-5.1, Gemini 2.0 Pro, Llama 3, Qwen, and BioGPT) across five KGs: DrugBank, NeuroSynth, Cognitive Atlas, Brain Map, and GDPKG. We introduce a multitier query dataset to evaluate reasoning depth and factual accuracy under KG-aware (graph-grounded) and KG-agnostic conditions. Inter-annotator agreement was substantial, with Cohen's kappa of 0.781 (range: 0.753-0.807) and Fleiss' kappa of 0.77. Results show that general-purpose models, particularly GPT-5.1 and Gemini 2.0 Pro, generally outperform domain-specific models on multi-hop and high-level reasoning tasks, although performance declines as query complexity increases. KG grounding reduces hallucination rates across all evaluated models. Contrary to our initial hypothesis, domain-specific models do not consistently outperform general-purpose models on specialized tasks without graph grounding. These findings highlight the value of combining broad language-model capabilities with structured domain knowledge. We provide practical guidance for selecting LLM-KG integration strategies based on task complexity and computational constraints, and discuss hybrid neurosymbolic architectures for personalized medicine, cognitive disorder diagnosis, and explainable AI.
zh_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLMs）正越来越多地用于生物医学和认知神经科学，但它们对异构知识图谱（KGs）进行可靠推理的能力仍不清楚。我们在五个KG（DrugBank、NeuroSynth、Cognitive Atlas、Brain Map和GDPKG）上对五个LLM（GPT-5.1、Gemini 2.0 Pro、Llama 3、Qwen和BioGPT）进行基准测试。我们引入一个多层级查询数据集，以评估在KG感知（图接地）和KG不可知条件下的推理深度和事实准确性。标注者间一致性达到实质性水平，Cohen's kappa为0.781（范围：0.753-0.807），Fleiss' kappa为0.77。结果表明，通用模型，尤其是GPT-5.1和Gemini 2.0 Pro，在多跳和高层次推理任务上通常优于领域特定模型，尽管性能随查询复杂度增加而下降。KG接地降低了所有评估模型的幻觉率。与我们的初始假设相反，在没有图接地的情况下，领域特定模型在专门任务上并不一致优于通用模型。这些发现凸显了将广泛的语言模型能力与结构化领域知识相结合的价值。我们根据任务复杂性和计算约束为选择LLM-KG集成策略提供实用指导，并讨论用于个性化医疗、认知障碍诊断和可解释AI的混合神经符号架构。

title: LLM-Assisted Label Noise Correction for EEG-Based Sleep Stage Classification
zh_title: LLM辅助标签噪声校正用于脑电睡眠分期
summary: 提出在训练阶段用LLaMA 3.1结合脑电频谱特征与序列上下文筛除低置信度睡眠分期标注，再重训TinySleepNet。

低置信度片段交LLaMA 3.1按AASM标准复核
仅用于训练阶段，不改变推理流程
reason: 预印本新方法，有基线与既有流程对比但证据有限，值得一看档
abstract: Automatic sleep stage classification from electroencephalography (EEG) signals is a critical task in clinical sleep medicine. While deep learning models have shown promising results in this domain, their performance is fundamentally constrained by the quality of training labels, which human experts manually annotate and that are subject to inter-rater disagreement and systematic labeling errors. In this paper, we propose a novel LLM-assisted label-noise filtering pipeline that operates exclusively during training to identify and remove unreliable sleep-stage annotations before retraining the classifier. Specifically, TinySleepNet is first trained on the original dataset to extract per-epoch SoftMax confidence scores, then low-confidence epochs are submitted to LLaMA 3.1 along with their EEG spectral features and surrounding sequence context. The LLM evaluates each epoch against AASM sleep-scoring guidelines and assigns a verdict of RELIABLE or SUSPICIOUS. Suspicious epochs are removed from the training set, and TinySleepNet is retrained on the cleaned data. Evaluated on the Sleep-EDF Expanded dataset using 20-fold cross-validation, our method improves overall accuracy from 81.8% to 84.6% and Macro F1-score from 75.6% to 77.4%, with particularly notable gains in REM detection. Crucially, because the LLM operates only during training, the lightweight TinySleepNet architecture (1.3M parameters) is preserved at inference, making the proposed pipeline suitable for real-time, wearable sleep monitoring applications.
zh_abstract: 基于脑电图（EEG）信号的自动睡眠分期分类是临床睡眠医学中的一项关键任务。尽管深度学习模型在该领域已显示出有希望的结果，但其性能从根本上受训练标签质量制约，这些标签由人类专家手动标注，且易受评分者间不一致和系统性标注错误影响。本文提出一种新颖的 LLM 辅助标签噪声过滤流程，该流程仅在训练期间运行，以在重新训练分类器之前识别并移除不可靠的睡眠分期标注。具体而言，首先在原始数据集上训练 TinySleepNet 以提取每个 epoch 的 SoftMax 置信度分数，然后将低置信度 epoch 连同其 EEG 频谱特征和周围序列上下文提交给 LLaMA 3.1。LLM 根据 AASM 睡眠评分指南评估每个 epoch，并给出可靠（RELIABLE）或可疑（SUSPICIOUS）的判定。可疑 epoch 从训练集中移除，并在清洗后的数据上重新训练 TinySleepNet。在 Sleep-EDF Expanded 数据集上使用20折交叉验证进行评估，我们的方法将总体准确率从81.8%提高到84.6%，Macro F1-score 从75.6%提高到77.4%，在 REM 检测方面提升尤为显著。至关重要的是，由于 LLM 仅在训练期间运行，轻量级 TinySleepNet 架构（130万参数）在推理时得以保留，使所提出的流程适用于实时、可穿戴睡眠监测应用。

title: Generative Models for Novel Enzymatic Reactions: How Far Do They Go?
zh_title: 生成模型预测新酶促反应的能力评估
summary: 研究检验结构条件生成模型能否仅由酶生成训练数据中未出现的完整生化反应，并与BLASTp、CLIPZyme、RxnPred比较。

现有方法在设计上无法输出未见反应
以精确回收而非指纹相似度作为更严格判据
