abstract: Enzyme function prediction is a long-standing problem in biology, and deep learning methods have recently become popular to improve performance on this task. While most of these models focus on classifying enzymes or mapping them to known reactions, predicting unknown biochemical reactions remains underexplored. Here we thoroughly examine an approach that generates reactions absent from the training data from the enzyme alone. Existing methods such as BLASTp or CLIPZyme cannot, by design, output reactions that are absent from their training data or were not supplied at inference. The closest prior model, RxnPred, reports high fingerprint-similarity scores on held-out enzymes, a less stringent criterion than exact recovery, but fails to recover the correct answer on unseen reactions. We present a structure-conditioned generative model that outputs a complete reaction, reactants and products, and evaluate it on EnzymeMap_x, a reaction-disjoint benchmark in which no test reaction appears in training, under exact, stereo-respecting scoring. On this benchmark, within 400 sampled candidates, the model generates the complete, correct reaction for 25.0% of the subset of test enzyme--reaction pairs whose reaction is a new combination of metabolites seen in training. Surprisingly, it also correctly generates a few reactions composed of metabolites it has not seen in training (1.6%), though their embeddings are present in the vocabulary. With a lower budget, re-ranking places the correct reaction first for 5.6% of pairs and in the top ten for 12.4%, when the reaction is assumed not to be already known (0.2% and 8.1% without that assumption) along with confidence scores. Assessed more leniently, the model produces at least one correct reaction known for the enzyme (usually memorised from training) for 71.2% of test pairs. Going further, without any retraining, a sequence-only model given the reactants as well as the enzyme produces the correct product set for 9.5% of pairs within five candidates, without re-ranking. We also present head-to-head comparisons on these tasks with BLASTp, DIAMOND, RxnPred and Horizyn. Structure conditioning improves fingerprint similarity on homology-stratified splits, but a matched sequence-only ablation at the best configuration finds no measurable effect on exact recovery. Data coverage and chemical initialisation of the vocabulary seem to matter more than encoder geometry.
zh_abstract: 酶功能预测是生物学中长期存在的问题，深度学习方法近来因能提升该任务性能而流行。虽然这些模型大多集中于对酶进行分类或将其映射到已知反应，但预测未知生化反应仍研究不足。在此我们全面考察一种仅根据酶生成训练数据中不存在的反应的方法。现有方法如 BLASTp 或 CLIPZyme 按设计无法输出其训练数据中不存在或推断时未提供的反应。最接近的先前模型 RxnPred 在留出酶上报告了高指纹相似性得分，这一标准不如精确恢复严格，但未能对未见反应恢复正确答案。我们提出一种结构条件生成模型，输出完整反应，即反应物和产物，并在 EnzymeMap_x 上评估它；EnzymeMap_x 是一个反应不相交基准，其中没有测试反应出现在训练中，采用精确、尊重立体化学的评分。在该基准上，在 400 个采样候选内，对于反应为训练中见过的代谢物新组合的测试酶-反应对子集，模型为其中 25.0% 生成完整且正确的反应。令人惊讶的是，它还能正确生成少数由训练中未见过代谢物组成的反应（1.6%），尽管这些代谢物的嵌入存在于词汇表中。在较低预算下，当假定反应尚未已知时，重排序将正确反应排在 5.6% 对子的第一位、12.4% 对子的前十位（若不采用该假设则为 0.2% 和 8.1%），并附带置信分数。以更宽松的方式评估，模型为 71.2% 的测试对子产生至少一个该酶已知的正确反应（通常是从训练中记忆的）。更进一步，在没有任何再训练的情况下，一个仅基于序列的模型在同时给定反应物和酶时，在五个候选内为 9.5% 的对子产生正确产物集合，且无需重排序。我们还展示了在这些任务上与 BLASTp、DIAMOND、RxnPred 和 Horizyn 的正面比较。结构条件化提高了同源性分层划分上的指纹相似性，但在最佳配置下匹配的仅序列消融未发现对精确恢复有可测量影响。数据覆盖度和词汇表的化学初始化似乎比编码器几何结构更重要。

title: USB Gym: A Gymnasium Testbed for Closed-Loop Ultrasound View Matching
zh_title: USB Gym：闭环超声切面匹配测试平台
summary: 基于公开CT模拟超声，构建可替换模块的闭环探头导航测试平台，并用以比较20种已发表方法。
key_points: 由公开患者CT模拟超声图像
分割器、控制器、奖励三模块可替换
20种方法在6例留出患者的60个回合上比较
reason: 预印本基准平台，有方法对比但样本与验证规模有限，值得一看档。
abstract: Background and Objective: Our main goal is ultrasound guidance: moving a probe until its image matches a target view. Published methods for each part of a guide are evaluated in separate simulators. We asked whether these methods, combined into one guide, are good enough. Methods: We built USB Gym, a testbed whose standard engine simulates ultrasound from public patient CT, with a network drawing organ textures from CT labels. Its guide has three replaceable parts (slots), an organ segmenter, a controller and a reward, which received 20 published methods, each run on the same 60 episodes of six held-out patients. In each slot, a published method replaced ours only if detectably better on these patients. The better of this combination and our original guide on 20 new CTs is the benchmark baseline. A pose oracle, reading the exact probe pose available only in simulation, set the reference. The results below are exploratory. Results: On these CTs, the probe started on average 16.0 mm from the target view; the pose oracle brought it to 1.5 mm. Of the results known when the combination was fixed, only an image-similarity reward (SSIM) was slightly but detectably better, so the combination was our guide with that reward. This combination was the benchmark baseline, ending at 13.7 mm (16% of the oracle's progress). Conclusions: Combining untuned published methods with ours did not guide the probe near the target view; the task remains under-explored. The testbed accepts new methods; no guide was tested on hardware.
zh_abstract: 【背景与目的】我们的主要目标是超声引导：移动探头直到其图像与目标视图匹配。已发表的用于引导各组成部分的方法在各自独立的模拟器中评估。我们询问，将这些方法组合成一个引导系统后是否足够好。【方法】我们构建了 USB Gym，一个测试平台，其标准引擎根据公开患者 CT 模拟超声，并有一个网络从 CT 标签中提取器官纹理。其引导系统有三个可替换部分（槽位）：器官分割器、控制器和奖励；它接收了 20 种已发表方法，每种方法均在六名留出患者的相同 60 个回合上运行。在每个槽位中，只有当一种已发表方法在这些患者上可检测地更好时，才替换我们的方法。该组合与我们原始引导系统在 20 个新 CT 上较好的那个作为基准基线。一个姿态预言机读取仅在模拟中可用的精确探头姿态，设定参考。以下结果为探索性结果。【结果】在这些 CT 上，探头起始时平均距离目标视图 16.0 mm；姿态预言机将其带到 1.5 mm。在固定组合时已知的结果中，只有图像相似性奖励（SSIM）略好且可检测地更好，因此该组合是我们的引导系统加上该奖励。该组合是基准基线，最终达到 13.7 mm（为预言机进展的 16%）。【结论】将未经调优的已发表方法与我们的方法组合，并未引导探头接近目标视图；该任务仍研究不足。该测试平台接受新方法；尚无引导系统在硬件上测试。

title: Synthesis of Ovarian Cancer Multi-Omics Datasets: A Biology-Informed Evaluation Framework
zh_title: 卵巢癌多组学合成数据的生物学导向评估框架
summary: 提出面向配对RNA表达与CNV合成数据的生物学导向、患者不重叠评估框架，并在DECIDER高级别浆液性卵巢癌队列上应用。
key_points: 以真实训练集与留出数据一致性为参照
评估模态内保真度与RNA-CNV配对一致性
改造并比较三种多组学整合架构
reason: 预印本提出评估框架，属有新意但证据有限档，未经同行评审
abstract: Paired multi-omic cancer cohorts are costly to assemble and difficult to share, motivating synthetic cohorts as a complementary resource. As generative model development accelerates, we shift the focus from proposing yet another architecture to defining evaluation criteria that determine whether synthetic data preserve biologically relevant structure. We introduce a biology-informed and patient-disjoint framework for evaluating the generation of paired RNA expression and copy-number variation (CNV) profiles, and apply it to the longitudinal DECIDER high-grade serous ovarian cancer cohort. The framework assesses modality-specific fidelity and coherence between RNA and CNV pairs using agreement between real training and held-out data as a reference, alongside complementary training-data proximity diagnostics. We adapt three multi-omic integration architectures based on variational autoencoders to generate paired profiles. The model leading several fidelity and coherence measures also shows the strongest training-data proximity. The protocol and case study offer the community a reference for comparing future multi-omic generators.
zh_abstract: 配对多组学癌症队列的组装成本高昂且难以共享，这促使合成队列成为一种补充资源。随着生成模型开发加速，我们将重点从提出又一种架构转向定义评估标准，以确定合成数据是否保留生物学相关结构。我们引入一个生物学信息指导且患者不重叠的框架，用于评估配对 RNA 表达与拷贝数变异（CNV）谱的生成，并将其应用于纵向 DECIDER 高级别浆液性卵巢癌队列。该框架以真实训练数据与留出数据之间的一致性为参考，评估模态特异性保真度以及 RNA 与 CNV 配对之间的连贯性，同时辅以训练数据接近度诊断。我们改编了三种基于变分自编码器的多组学整合架构来生成配对谱。在多项保真度和连贯性指标上领先的模型也表现出最强的训练数据接近度。该方案和案例研究为社区比较未来的多组学生成器提供了参考。

title: Multimodal Hierarchical Mixture-of-Experts for 3D Medical Vision-Language Modeling
zh_title: 面向3D医学视觉语言建模的多模态分层专家混合
summary: 提出MedHiVE，用解剖尺度两级软专家混合与报告衍生的解剖级对比对齐建模3D扫描与报告。
key_points: 按解剖尺度组织两级软专家混合路由
视觉与文本token均参与分层路由
结合报告衍生的解剖级对比学习
reason: 预印本方法有新意，但未见外部验证或开源说明，值得一看档。
abstract: Medical 3D scans and reports are inherently hierarchical, with diagnostic cues concentrated in specific anatomical regions across multiple levels of organization. Yet, most medical vision-language models ignore this structure and fail to focus on clinically relevant anatomy. We introduce MedHiVE, which combines hierarchical vision-language Soft Mixture-of-Experts (SMoE) with contrastive learning to jointly model fine-grained anatomy and global scan context. To our knowledge, MedHiVE is the first framework to route both vision and text tokens through a two-level SMoE hierarchy organized by anatomical scale, coupling this with report-derived anatomy-level contrastive alignment for 3D medical imaging. This replaces the direct region-text alignment of statically pooled features and vision-only hierarchical routing of prior work with dynamic, slot-based cross-modal information flow across anatomical scales. MedHiVE operates via a two-level, learnable token-routing mechanism, where local image and text features are first routed through a local SMoE and then fused by a global SMoE into unified multimodal representations. Contrastive learning aligns both anatomy-level and global vision-language representations in a unified space. Pre-trained on 25,000+ CT scans with anatomical supervision, MedHiVE consistently surpasses 11 state-of-the-art methods across 6 datasets on 3 tasks: segmentation, classification, and detection, demonstrating the importance of hierarchical modeling. The code for MedHiVE is at github.com/szczurek-lab/MedHiVE.
zh_abstract: 医学3D扫描和报告本质上是层级化的，诊断线索集中在多个组织层级的特定解剖区域。然而，大多数医学视觉-语言模型忽略这种结构，未能聚焦于临床相关解剖。我们介绍MedHiVE，它将层级化视觉-语言软混合专家（SMoE）与对比学习相结合，以联合建模细粒度解剖结构和全局扫描上下文。据我们所知，MedHiVE是首个通过按解剖尺度组织的两级SMoE层级路由视觉和文本token的框架，并将其与用于3D医学影像的报告衍生的解剖层面对比对齐相结合。这取代了先前工作中静态池化特征的直接区域-文本对齐和仅视觉的层级路由，转而采用跨解剖尺度的动态、基于槽的跨模态信息流。MedHiVE通过两级可学习token路由机制运行，其中局部图像和文本特征首先通过局部SMoE路由，然后由全局SMoE融合为统一多模态表征。对比学习在统一空间中对齐解剖层面和全局视觉-语言表征。MedHiVE在25,000+例CT扫描上以解剖监督进行预训练，在6个数据集、3项任务（分割、分类和检测）上持续超越11种最先进方法，证明层级化建模的重要性。MedHiVE的代码见github.com/szczurek-lab/MedHiVE。

title: ProtoGestalt: Interpretable Prototypes for Facial Phenotyping and Diagnosis of Rare Genetic Disorders
zh_title: ProtoGestalt：用于罕见遗传病面部表型与诊断的可解释原型
summary: 提出基于原型的可解释框架，通过受限于面部区域的视觉特征做罕见遗传病筛查与综合征识别。
key_points: 预测可分解为局部、可加的原型证据
在多套对照数据集与不同患病率下评估区分能力
对训练中出现的综合征评估诊断性能
reason: 方法有新意且强调可解释性，但为预印本、缺外部临床验证
abstract: Rare genetic disorders are difficult to diagnose due to their diversity and overlapping clinical features. Facial morphology can provide diagnostic clues, yet most diagnostic models offer limited interpretability and are not designed to support broad screening for undiagnosed disease. We present ProtoGestalt, an interpretable prototype-based framework for facial phenotyping, rare-disease screening, and syndrome identification. The method extends prototype learning by constraining learned visual features to select facial regions, allowing predictions to be explained through localized and additive evidence. We assess ProtoGestalt's ability to distinguish syndromic from unaffected faces on multiple control datasets and class prevalence values. We further evaluate it's diagnostic performance on syndromes observed during training. The learned prototype-based representations provide significant separation between syndromic and case-matched control images and retain useful performance as the proportion of controls increases. The framework also demonstrates the ability to differentiate among syndromes. Although reasonably accurate specialized models for facial classification of rare disorders already exist, ProtoGestalt offers an interpretable alternative that links predictions to anatomically meaningful facial regions, potentially supporting clinical decision-making and the discovery of phenotype-gene associations.
zh_abstract: 罕见遗传病因其多样性和临床特征重叠而难以诊断。面部形态可提供诊断线索，但大多数诊断模型可解释性有限，且并非为支持对未诊断疾病进行广泛筛查而设计。我们提出ProtoGestalt，一个用于面部表型分析、罕见病筛查和综合征识别的可解释的基于原型的框架。该方法通过约束学习到的视觉特征以选择面部区域来扩展原型学习，使预测可通过局部化且可加的证据加以解释。我们在多个对照数据集和类别患病率值上评估ProtoGestalt区分综合征面容与未受累面容的能力。我们进一步评估其在训练期间观察到的综合征上的诊断性能。学习到的基于原型的表征在综合征图像与病例匹配的对照图像之间提供显著分离，并在对照比例增加时保持有用性能。该框架还展示出区分不同综合征的能力。尽管用于罕见病面部分类的专用模型已经存在且具有合理准确性，ProtoGestalt提供了一种可解释的替代方案，将预测与解剖学上有意义的面部区域联系起来，可能支持临床决策和表型-基因关联的发现。

summary: 登记一项100例前瞻性观察研究，用智能床垫采集血氧与心冲击图信号，训练多模态深度学习模型估计AHI。

abstract: [Newly registered clinical trial, no results yet; sponsor: Fu Jen Catholic University; conditions: Obstructive Sleep Apnea; type: OBSERVATIONAL; enrollment: 100; status: RECRUITING] Obstructive sleep apnea (OSA) is a common sleep disorder associated with cardiovascular, metabolic, and neurocognitive complications. The standard diagnostic test for OSA is in-laboratory polysomnography (PSG), which can be costly, labor-intensive, and inconvenient for repeated or large-scale screening. Therefore, there is a need for a convenient and non-invasive method to help identify individuals who may be at risk for OSA. This prospective observational study aims to develop and clinically validate a multimodal deep learning model that integrates peripheral oxygen saturation (SpO₂) signals and ballistocardiography (BCG) data collected using a smart mattress system to estimate the apnea-hypopnea index (AHI). Adult participants undergoing routine overnight PSG for suspected OSA will be enrolled. During sleep, synchronized SpO₂ and BCG signals will be recorded non-invasively. The performance of the deep learning model will be evaluated by comparing the predicted AHI values with AHI values derived from PSG. This study seeks to evaluate whether this practical, non-invasive, and scalable approach may support early identification of OSA risk and improve access to sleep disorder assessment in both clinical and home-based settings.
zh_abstract: [新注册临床试验，尚无结果；申办方：辅仁天主教大学；疾病：阻塞性睡眠呼吸暂停；类型：观察性；入组人数：100；状态：招募中] 阻塞性睡眠呼吸暂停（OSA）是一种常见睡眠障碍，与心血管、代谢和神经认知并发症相关。OSA 的标准诊断检查是实验室多导睡眠图（PSG），但其费用高、劳动强度大，且不便于重复或大规模筛查。因此，需要一种便捷且无创的方法来帮助识别可能处于 OSA 风险中的个体。这项前瞻性观察性研究旨在开发并临床验证一种多模态深度学习模型，该模型整合通过智能床垫系统采集的外周血氧饱和度（SpO₂）信号和心冲击图（BCG）数据，以估算呼吸暂停低通气指数（AHI）。研究将纳入因疑似 OSA 接受常规整夜 PSG 的成年参与者。睡眠期间，将无创记录同步的 SpO₂ 和 BCG 信号。将通过比较预测 AHI 值与 PSG 得出的 AHI 值来评估深度学习模型的性能。本研究旨在评估这种实用、无创且可扩展的方法是否可支持 OSA 风险的早期识别，并改善临床和家庭环境中睡眠障碍评估的可及性。

abstract: [Annals of biomedical engineering] The convergence of artificial intelligence (AI) and smart hydrogel-based additive manufacturing offers new capabilities for fabricating adaptive structures, though the field remains in early stages of translation. Smart hydrogels, with their stimuli-responsive properties and biocompatibility, present opportunities in tissue engineering, drug delivery, and soft robotics. However, the complexity of their material behavior and the challenges of high-resolution four-dimensional (4D) printing demand advanced computational approaches to optimize design, processing, and performance. This review systematically examines the role of AI, encompassing machine learning (ML), deep learning (DL), and generative models, in addressing these challenges. We critically assess AI-driven strategies for hydrogel formulation, real-time process control, structural optimization, and biological outcome prediction, distinguishing between retrospectively fitted models and prospectively validated implementations. A key contribution of this review is the clear differentiation between AI-assisted 3D printing and genuine 4D printing, where constructs exhibit time-dependent shape change, actuation, or degradation in response to stimuli. We introduce AI applications in specific hydrogel printing domains, provide a comparative framework for distinguishing 3D from 4D systems, and critically evaluate quantitative claims with attention to dataset size, validation approaches, and reproducibility. Case studies highlight where AI enhances printability, resolution, and functional outcomes, while we also identify persistent limitations including data scarcity, model interpretability, and regulatory hurdles. A comparative analysis of AI-assisted versus traditional design-of-experiment strategies reveals that while AI offers advantages in high-dimensional spaces, traditional methods remain more accessible, interpretable, and reproducible for simpler systems. By synthesizing recent advancements with transparent methodology and practical guidance, this study provides a roadmap for future research at the intersection of AI and smart hydrogel additive manufacturing, advocating for interdisciplinary collaboration and standardized reporting to enable next-generation innovations.
zh_abstract: 【综述】人工智能（AI）与基于智能水凝胶的增材制造的融合为制造自适应结构提供了新能力，尽管该领域的转化仍处于早期阶段。智能水凝胶具有刺激响应特性和生物相容性，在组织工程、药物递送和软体机器人中提供了机遇。然而，其材料行为的复杂性以及高分辨率四维（4D）打印的挑战，要求采用先进的计算方法来优化设计、加工和性能。本综述系统考察AI——包括机器学习（ML）、深度学习（DL）和生成模型——在应对这些挑战中的作用。我们批判性评估AI驱动的水凝胶配方、实时过程控制、结构优化和生物学结果预测策略，并区分回顾性拟合模型与前瞻性验证实现。本综述的一个关键贡献是清晰区分AI辅助3D打印与真正的4D打印，后者中构建体响应刺激表现出时间依赖性形状变化、驱动或降解。我们介绍AI在特定水凝胶打印领域中的应用，提供区分3D与4D系统的比较框架，并批判性评估定量主张，关注数据集规模、验证方法和可重复性。案例研究强调AI在提高可打印性、分辨率和功能结果方面的作用，同时我们也指出持续存在的局限性，包括数据稀缺、模型可解释性和监管障碍。对AI辅助策略与传统实验设计策略的比较分析显示，尽管AI在高维空间中具有优势，传统方法对于更简单的系统仍然更易获得、更易解释且更可重复。通过以透明的方法学和实践指导综合近期进展，本研究为AI与智能水凝胶增材制造交叉领域的未来研究提供路线图，倡导跨学科合作和标准化报告以实现下一代创新。

abstract: [bioRxiv : the preprint server for biology] Autonomous artificial intelligence agents are transforming the practice of science. Across every discipline, researchers are handing data analysis to coding agents that can design and execute complex studies from a single prompt. Yet this revolution carries a threat. When agents improvise in local environments, they leave no verifiable record, ultimately risking a wave of irreproducible science. Solving this crisis requires moving agentic science onto public infrastructure where every action leaves an examinable trail. Here we connect autonomous coding agents to shared computing resources, turning ephemeral prompts into auditable scientific records. After showing that 30 unguided local agents splinter into 18 incompatible pipelines on the same dataset, we conduct an agentic reproduction and discovery study on a large scale-reproducing a large, diverse array of studies with every workflow, history, and intermediate dataset publicly accessible. This complete provenance trail exposes unstated modeling choices, reference mismatches, and subsampled tutorial inputs in published studies, and establishes a new foundation where human scientists can understand, steer, and trust AI-driven discovery.
zh_abstract: [bioRxiv : the preprint server for biology] 自主人工智能（AI）智能体正在改变科学实践。在每个学科中，研究人员正将数据分析交给编码智能体，这些智能体可以从单个提示设计并执行复杂研究。然而这场革命伴随威胁。当智能体在本地环境中即兴操作时，它们不留下可验证记录，最终可能造成一波不可复现的科学。解决这一危机需要将智能体驱动的科学转移到公共基础设施上，使每个动作都留下可检查的轨迹。在这里，我们将自主编码智能体连接到共享计算资源，把短暂的提示转化为可审计的科学记录。在展示30个未引导的本地智能体在同一数据集上分裂为18条不兼容流水线之后，我们开展了一项大规模的智能体复现与发现研究——复现大量多样化研究，且每个工作流程、历史记录和中间数据集均可公开访问。这一完整的来源追踪轨迹揭示了已发表研究中未明示的建模选择、参考不匹配和子采样教程输入，并建立了一个新基础，使人类科学家能够理解、引导并信任AI驱动的发现。

title: Wetter's Digital Twin: A Patient-Specific Framework for Artificial Intelligence and Healthcare.
source: PubMed · JSLS : Journal of the Society of Laparoendoscopic Surgeons

summary: 提出Wetter数字孪生概念，整合个人健康信息、AI与人群数据，构建患者动态虚拟模型以辅助手术准备。

abstract: [JSLS : Journal of the Society of Laparoendoscopic Surgeons] The concept of ORReady began with a simple goal: to better prepare the patient, surgeon, operating team, and operating room (OR) environment to improve surgical outcomes. Advances in artificial intelligence, large datasets, electronic health records, imaging, physiological monitoring, wearable technologies, and predictive analytics now create an opportunity to take that concept considerably further. Digital twins, originally developed in engineering, use evolving virtual representations of physical systems to model performance and test possible interventions before they are applied. We propose Wetter's Digital Twin (WDT) as an individualized, dynamic model of the patient that integrates personal health information with artificial intelligence, medical knowledge, and relevant population data. Unlike the conventional medical record, which primarily documents what has occurred, WDT would help clinicians understand what may happen next and explore how different interventions might alter that course. In surgery, such a model could assist with preoperative optimization, procedure selection and planning, intraoperative decision support, and postoperative recovery. The concept, however, extends beyond surgery. The same longitudinal patient-specific model could contribute to prevention, diagnosis, medical treatment, chronic disease management, rehabilitation, and long-term health planning. WDT is proposed not as a replacement for physician judgment or patient participation, but as a means of making increasingly complex health information more useful to both. Important challenges involving data integration, validation, privacy, security, bias, regulation, and clinical responsibility remain. The transition from a medical record that primarily records the past toward a patient-specific model that can also evaluate possible futures may represent an important next step in healthcare.
zh_abstract: [JSLS : Journal of the Society of Laparoendoscopic Surgeons] ORReady的概念始于一个简单目标：更好地为患者、外科医生、手术团队和手术室（OR）环境做好准备，以改善手术结局。人工智能、大型数据集、电子健康记录、影像、生理监测、可穿戴技术和预测分析的进步，如今为将该概念大幅推进创造了机会。数字孪生最初在工程领域开发，使用物理系统的演进虚拟表示来建模性能，并在实施可能的干预措施之前进行测试。我们提出Wetter的数字孪生（Wetter's Digital Twin, WDT），作为患者的个体化、动态模型，将个人健康信息与人工智能、医学知识和相关人群数据整合。与传统病历主要记录已经发生的情况不同，WDT将帮助临床医生理解接下来可能发生什么，并探索不同干预措施可能如何改变该进程。在外科领域，此类模型可协助术前优化、术式选择和规划、术中决策支持以及术后康复。然而，该概念超越外科。相同的纵向患者特异性模型可有助于预防、诊断、医疗、慢性病管理、康复和长期健康规划。提出WDT并非作为医生判断或患者参与的替代，而是作为一种使日益复杂的健康信息对二者更有用的手段。涉及数据整合、验证、隐私、安全、偏倚、监管和临床责任的重要挑战仍然存在。从主要记录过去的病历，转向也可评估可能未来的患者特异性模型，可能代表医疗保健的重要下一步。

title: AI Identifies Clinically Relevant Asystole Among False Loop Recorder Alerts: From Data Overload to Diagnosis.

abstract: [JACC. Case reports] Implantable loop recorders (ILRs) are often implanted to investigate unexplained syncopal episodes. However, ILRs may produce false alerts due to undersensing or artifacts, thus requiring careful review of numerous device recordings, which makes it challenging to identify clinically significant events. We report a case of a 77-year-old woman with recurrent syncopal episodes, in whom a 7-second pause was detected by an ILR. Device interrogations showed multiple pause alerts that were identified as false events because of poor R sensing. However, the artificial intelligence (AI)-enhanced remote monitoring identified a true pause with blocked P waves, leading the patient to receive a pacemaker implantation. This case highlights the clinical value of AI-assisted remote monitoring in identifying clinically relevant arrhythmias among numerous device alerts. Improved automated filtering of ILR data may reduce diagnostic delays and help clinicians prioritize clinically significant events. ILRs may generate numerous false alerts because of sensing abnormalities, complicating the identification of clinically relevant events in routine practice. AI-enhanced remote monitoring may improve diagnostic efficiency by identifying true arrhythmic events within large volumes of device-generated data and guiding timely management.
zh_abstract: [JACC. Case Reports] 植入式循环记录器（implantable loop recorders, ILRs）常被植入以查明不明原因晕厥发作。然而，ILRs可能因感知不足或伪差而产生假警报，因此需要仔细审阅大量设备记录，这使得识别具有临床意义的事件具有挑战性。我们报告一例77岁女性，反复出现晕厥发作，其ILR检测到7秒停搏。设备程控检查显示多次停搏警报，这些警报因R波感知不良而被判定为假事件。然而，人工智能（artificial intelligence, AI）增强的远程监测识别出一次伴P波阻滞的真性停搏，使患者接受了起搏器植入。本病例凸显了AI辅助远程监测在大量设备警报中识别临床相关心律失常的临床价值。改进ILR数据的自动过滤可能减少诊断延迟，并帮助临床医生优先处理具有临床意义的事件。ILRs可能因感知异常产生大量假警报，使常规实践中识别临床相关事件复杂化。AI增强的远程监测可通过在大量设备生成数据中识别真性心律失常事件并指导及时管理，从而提高诊断效率。

abstract: [Frontiers in toxicology] ToxPipe is a modular, fully open-source software stack designed to accelerate toxicological data analysis and decision-making by integrating large language model (LLM) capabilities with workflow, monitoring, and user-interface services. ToxPipe leverages existing open-source technologies like LibreChat, LiteLLM, and Langflow to provide centralized and streamlined access to different LLMs for end users and developers and logging and auditing of LLM use for organizations. ToxPipe also allows for open-source/local model support. While the ToxPipe ecosystem also supports advanced AI functions such as MCP server integration, RAG and literature search, and agent creation, we did not observe clear benefits using these configurations relative to the GPT-5.5 baseline assertion coverage scores. ToxPipe is available as a series of Docker containers for rapid and reproducible deployment.

title: Mathematical foundations of artificial intelligence in healthcare: a systematic review.
zh_title: 医疗AI数学基础的系统综述
summary: 系统综述汇总2016年以来147项研究，梳理医疗AI所依赖的数学框架与方法学趋势。
key_points: 按PRISMA 2020检索三大数据库
653条记录中147项纳入分析
用VOSviewer做文献计量、AMSTAR-2评质量
reason: 综述类最高6分；主题宽泛、无具体模型或临床结果，属增量档
abstract: [Frontiers in artificial intelligence] Artificial intelligence (AI) in healthcare relies on diverse mathematical frameworks, yet their contributions to model development, evaluation, interpretability, and clinical translation remain fragmented. This systematic review synthesized the classical and emerging mathematical foundations underpinning healthcare AI and examined major methodological and application trends. Following PRISMA 2020 guidelines, studies published between January 2016 and June 30, 2026, were identified through systematic searches of Scopus, Google Scholar, and PubMed/MEDLINE, with searches conducted using Harzing's Publish or Perish v8 where applicable. Bibliometric analysis was performed using VOSviewer, while methodological quality was assessed using an adapted JBI-based framework and AMSTAR-2 for systematic reviews. Of 653 records identified, 147 studies met the eligibility criteria. Non-mutually exclusive mathematical-domain coding identified linear algebra in 100/147 studies (68.0%), calculus and optimization in 91/147 (61.9%), and probability and statistics in 79/147 (53.7%), highlighting their roles in data representation, learning, optimization, inference, uncertainty quantification, and validation. A separate mutually exclusive classification of dominant methodological themes identified explainable and trustworthy AI in 24/147 studies (16.3%), statistics and learning theory in 23/147 (15.6%), probability and Bayesian methods in 23/147 (15.6%), calculus and optimization in 19/147 (12.9%), and linear algebra in 15/147 (10.2%). Radiology and medical imaging were the leading healthcare application (24.3%), while classification and diagnosis were the most frequent clinical task (17.1%). Overall, healthcare AI is supported by an interconnected mathematical ecosystem. Emerging approaches, including graph neural networks, Transformers, and quantum machine learning, require stronger external validation, standardized benchmarking, and rigorous evaluation for reliable clinical translation.
zh_abstract: [Frontiers in Artificial Intelligence] 医疗保健中的人工智能（AI）依赖多种数学框架，但这些框架对模型开发、评估、可解释性和临床转化的贡献仍较为分散。本系统综述综合了支撑医疗保健AI的经典与新兴数学基础，并考察了主要方法学与应用趋势。遵循PRISMA 2020指南，通过系统检索Scopus、Google Scholar和PubMed/MEDLINE识别2016年1月至2026年6月30日期间发表的研究，并在适用时使用Harzing's Publish or Perish v8进行检索。使用VOSviewer进行文献计量分析，同时采用改编的基于JBI的框架评估方法学质量，并使用AMSTAR-2评估系统综述。在识别的653条记录中，147项研究符合纳入标准。非互斥的数学领域编码在100/147项研究（68.0%）中识别出线性代数，在91/147项（61.9%）中识别出微积分与优化，在79/147项（53.7%）中识别出概率与统计，突出其在数据表示、学习、优化、推断、不确定性量化和验证中的作用。另一项针对主导方法学主题的互斥分类在24/147项研究（16.3%）中识别出可解释与可信AI，在23/147项（15.6%）中识别出统计与学习理论，在23/147项（15.6%）中识别出概率与贝叶斯方法，在19/147项（12.9%）中识别出微积分与优化，在15/147项（10.2%）中识别出线性代数。放射学与医学影像是领先的医疗保健应用（24.3%），而分类与诊断是最常见的临床任务（17.1%）。总体而言，医疗保健AI由一个相互关联的数学生态系统支撑。包括图神经网络、Transformers和量子机器学习在内的新兴方法，需要更强外部验证、标准化基准测试和严格评估，以实现可靠的临床转化。

abstract: [The Linacre quarterly] The role of artificial intelligence (AI) in medicine should be discussed following Pope Leo XIV's recent encyclical on AI and the need to protect human dignity in this era of advancing technology. As a result of its efficiency and accessibility to people for medical advice, AI is already starting to change healthcare. These advances may improve patient care, but medicine is about more than access to information. Medicine is a vocation motivated by the compassionate service to others, and this must be defended. Using the teachings of Antiqua et Nova and Magnifica Humanitas as a guide, this commentary discusses how Catholic bioethics can contribute to the integration of AI in clinical practice. These ethical principles can direct the proper use of AI while still upholding physicians' responsibilities to their patients. Physicians must recognize each patient's dignity and needs, which go beyond the knowledge that any algorithm can offer. Furthermore, the recommendations that these AI systems provide are only as strong as the information available to them, emphasizing the continued importance of the physician's clinical judgment. As we continue to monitor the emergence and growth of AI, the Church serves as a reminder to us that AI should support physicians' clinical judgment while preserving the sacred relationship of trust between physician and patient.

abstract: Quantum annealing (QA) has been explored as an approach for protein design in vast combinatorial sequence spaces. Applying QA to protein sequence design requires amino acid sequences to be encoded as binary vectors, and optimized vectors to be decoded back into amino acid sequences. Thus, both the quality of binary encoding and sequence reconstruction accuracy are important for effective QA-based optimization. Binary variational autoencoder (bVAE) has been used to map protein sequences to binary representations in QA-based protein sequence design. However, bVAE was originally developed for natural language modeling, and its suitability for proteins has not been systematically evaluated. Here, we present pLM-bVAE, which incorporates protein representations derived from a pretrained protein language model (pLM) into the original bVAE model. In computational experiments on three public protein variant datasets, pLM-bVAE showed higher sequence reconstruction accuracy and binary encoding performance than bVAE. Moreover, we incorporated pLM-bVAE into a QA-based protein sequence design framework. Across all three datasets, pLM-bVAE generated more high-scoring sequences with greater sequence dissimilarity from the training and validation data than bVAE. Our results demonstrate that pLM-bVAE provides an effective binary representation for improving QA-based protein sequence design. Availability The source code used in this manuscript is available at https://github.com/hueda8/pLM-bVAE.
zh_abstract: 量子退火（QA）已被探索作为在庞大组合序列空间中进行蛋白质设计的一种方法。将 QA 应用于蛋白质序列设计需要将氨基酸序列编码为二进制向量，并将优化后的向量解码回氨基酸序列。因此，二进制编码的质量和序列重建准确性对于有效的基于 QA 的优化都很重要。二进制变分自编码器（bVAE）已被用于在基于 QA 的蛋白质序列设计中将蛋白质序列映射为二进制表示。然而，bVAE 最初是为自然语言建模开发的，其用于蛋白质的适用性尚未被系统评估。在此，我们提出 pLM-bVAE，它将从预训练蛋白质语言模型（pLM）获得的蛋白质表示整合到原始 bVAE 模型中。在三个公共蛋白质变体数据集上的计算实验中，pLM-bVAE 显示出比 bVAE 更高的序列重建准确性和二进制编码性能。此外，我们将 pLM-bVAE 纳入基于 QA 的蛋白质序列设计框架。在所有三个数据集上，与 bVAE 相比，pLM-bVAE 生成了更多高分序列，且这些序列与训练和验证数据的序列差异性更大。我们的结果表明，pLM-bVAE 提供了一种有效的二进制表示，用于改进基于 QA 的蛋白质序列设计。可用性 本手稿使用的源代码可在 https://github.com/hueda8/pLM-bVAE 获取。

abstract: Hybrid models that embed neural networks in ordinary differential equations are increasingly popular in bioprocess modeling, but they are challenging to set up. Much of the effort goes into the code around the model: wet-lab data must be imported and pre-processed, feeds and sampling must be accounted for in the balance equations, and a training loop with cross-validation must be set up. Researchers usually write this code from scratch for each project. In addition, no widely adopted format for bioprocess data exists, and datasets are mostly published in bespoke spreadsheets or not at all. As a result, models and datasets from the literature are difficult to reproduce, reuse, or compare.We present Hybrax, an open-source Python framework that addresses these problems. It combines a flexible format for bioprocess data with a customizable end-to-end training pipeline for mechanistic and hybrid models. Hybrax derives the transport terms in the process dynamics automatically and provides the utilities needed for training, so that researchers can focus on developing the model itself. It also facilitates model sharing and reproducibility: each training checkpoint contains the model parameters, code, configuration, and training data required to run the model or retrain it from scratch. We demonstrate Hybrax by re-implementing two models from the literature, one trained on real-world E. coli data and one on synthetic HEK293 data, with performance comparable to the original models. Hybrax is available at https://github.com/hybrax/hybrax.
zh_abstract: 将神经网络嵌入常微分方程的混合模型在生物过程建模中越来越受欢迎，但它们难以搭建。大部分工作花在模型周边的代码上：必须导入并预处理湿实验室数据，必须在平衡方程中考虑补料和采样，并且必须建立带交叉验证的训练循环。研究人员通常为每个项目从头编写这些代码。此外，生物过程数据尚无广泛采用的格式，数据集大多以定制的电子表格发布，或者根本不发布。因此，来自文献的模型和数据集难以复现、复用或比较。我们提出 Hybrax，一个解决这些问题的开源 Python 框架。它将灵活的生物过程数据格式与可定制的端到端训练流程相结合，适用于机理模型和混合模型。Hybrax 自动推导过程动力学中的传输项，并提供训练所需的实用工具，使研究人员能够专注于开发模型本身。它还促进模型共享和可复现性：每个训练检查点包含运行模型或从头重新训练所需的模型参数、代码、配置和训练数据。我们通过重新实现文献中的两个模型来演示 Hybrax，一个在真实世界大肠杆菌（E. coli）数据上训练，一个在合成 HEK293 数据上训练，性能与原始模型相当。Hybrax 可在 https://github.com/hybrax/hybrax 获取。

abstract: Robot-mediated rehabilitation has the potential to deliver high-intensity, individualized therapy, but existing systems (which have not consistently improved outcomes) typically prescribe kinematic trajectories rather than explicitly targeting the neuromotor activations thought to support recovery. To address this gap, and ultimately enable activation-optimizing rehabilitation robot behavior, we present a personalizable transformer-based model mapping individuals' muscle activations (as measured via surface electromyography) to prescribed contact force trajectories when interacting with an end-effector rehabilitation robot. The model uses a transformer encoder-decoder leveraging rotary positional embeddings (RoPE) to generate a latent representation of trajectory-relevant and user-specific neuromotor factors, and augments trajectory prediction with flow matching to produce a distribution over plausible prescriptions biased toward the training distribution. Using data from 16 healthy participants completing 15 isometric trajectory tracking tasks, we evaluate generalization across held-out tasks and users, as well as the feasibility of user-specific fine-tuning within a therapy-session timescale. The model achieves mean trajectory prediction errors of <8% on held out tasks and users, with effectively instantaneous deterministic inference and sub-second sampling of trajectory distributions. An initial test using the model during live rehabilitation tasks demonstrates that, on average, participants reach the target neuromotor activations with just 15% error accumulated throughout the task. These results provide a proof of concept for data-driven, activation-targeted trajectory prescription in robot-mediated rehabilitation and establish a foundation for future validation in clinical populations. Data and code have been open-sourced as part of the OpenRobotRehab project on SimTK.
zh_abstract: 机器人介导的康复有潜力提供高强度、个体化治疗，但现有系统（其结局并未持续改善）通常规定运动学轨迹，而非明确靶向被认为支持恢复的神经运动激活。为弥补这一空白，并最终实现以激活优化为目标的康复机器人行为，我们提出一种可个性化的基于 transformer 的模型，将个体肌肉激活（通过表面肌电测量）映射到与末端执行器康复机器人交互时规定的接触力轨迹。该模型使用采用旋转位置嵌入（RoPE）的 transformer 编码器-解码器，生成与轨迹相关且用户特异的神经运动因素的潜在表示，并通过流匹配增强轨迹预测，以产生偏向训练分布的合理处方分布。使用 16 名健康参与者完成 15 项等长轨迹跟踪任务的数据，我们评估了在留出任务和用户上的泛化能力，以及在治疗会话时间尺度内进行用户特异性微调的可行性。该模型在留出任务和用户上实现平均轨迹预测误差 <8%，具有实际上瞬时的确定性推理和亚秒级轨迹分布采样。在实时康复任务中对该模型的初步测试表明，平均而言，参与者在整个任务中累计仅 15% 的误差即达到目标神经运动激活。这些结果为机器人介导康复中数据驱动、以激活为靶点的轨迹处方提供了概念验证，并为未来在临床人群中的验证奠定了基础。数据和代码已在 SimTK 上作为 OpenRobotRehab 项目的一部分开源。

abstract: This study evaluates the added prognostic value of day-1 multimodal MRI for predicting three-month functional outcome after acute ischemic stroke (AIS). Sixty-six AIS patients with ADC, DWI, FLAIR, and clinical data were analyzed. Three-dimensional pretrained ResNet embeddings were extracted from each MRI modality, reduced using fold-isolated principal component analysis, and combined with structured clinical variables and ADC-derived lesion biomarkers. Linear support vector machines were evaluated using eight-fold stratified group cross-validation across MRI modality combinations. Clinical-only modeling achieved strong performance (AUC = $0.899 \pm 0.151$), while MRI-only models showed limited discrimination (AUC $\approx$ $0.67$-$0.73$). Among multimodal configurations, FLAIR-clinical fusion achieved the highest mean cross-validated performance (AUC = $0.948 \pm 0.061$), followed by ADC-clinical fusion (AUC = $0.941 \pm 0.094$). Full ADC-DWI-FLAIR fusion did not consistently outperform single-modality clinical fusion. Feature-importance analysis identified age, NIHSS subscores, ADC lesion burden, and learned FLAIR representations as key contributors, while qualitative FLAIR activation maps showed responses over lesion-like regions. These findings suggest that compact day-1 FLAIR and ADC representations provide complementary prognostic information beyond clinical variables and support interpretable, data-efficient outcome prediction in AIS.
zh_abstract: 本研究评估第1天多模态MRI对预测急性缺血性卒中（AIS）后3个月功能结局的附加预后价值。分析了66例具有ADC、DWI、FLAIR和临床数据的AIS患者。从每种MRI模态提取三维预训练ResNet嵌入，使用折隔离主成分分析降维，并与结构化临床变量和ADC衍生病变生物标志物相结合。使用八折分层分组交叉验证在MRI模态组合上评估线性支持向量机。仅临床建模取得较强性能（AUC = 0.899 ± 0.151），而仅MRI模型显示有限区分度（AUC ≈ 0.67–0.73）。在多模态配置中，FLAIR-临床融合取得最高平均交叉验证性能（AUC = 0.948 ± 0.061），其次是ADC-临床融合（AUC = 0.941 ± 0.094）。完整ADC-DWI-FLAIR融合并未始终优于单模态临床融合。特征重要性分析确定年龄、NIHSS亚评分、ADC病变负荷和学习到的FLAIR表征为关键贡献因素，而定性FLAIR激活图显示在病变样区域出现响应。这些发现表明，紧凑的第1天FLAIR和ADC表征提供超出临床变量的互补预后信息，并支持AIS中可解释、数据高效的结果预测。

abstract: In healthcare, protecting patient privacy is crucial due to the sensitivity of medical data and its extensive accessibility. Federated Learning (FL) offers a decentralized and privacy-preserving training paradigm, making it an ideal solution for healthcare applications. A critical challenge in healthcare is that real-world medical data often exhibits long-tailed distributions in local and global views. Existing methods addressing long-tailed FL problem typically assume that the model will be evaluated on uniform test data distribution. However, practical test data in healthcare systems is often agnostic and unpredictable, leading to potential model failures in real-world scenarios. In this paper, we introduce a novel task termed Test-Agnostic Long-Tailed Federated Learning and propose GTAFL, a comprehensive framework to address this challenge. During the training stage, GTAFL employs adaptive re-sampling, expert classifier retraining, and self-supervised learning to correct biased classifiers and distorted feature spaces caused by long-tailed training distributions. During the inference stage, an ensemble mechanism combines retrained expert classifiers to handle test data with unknown distributions. Extensive experiments on CIFAR10 and two medical datasets manifest that our framework outperforms other state-of-the-art methods. The code is available at https://github.com/cgy-lavine/GTAFL
zh_abstract: 在医疗保健中，由于医疗数据的敏感性及其广泛可及性，保护患者隐私至关重要。联邦学习（federated learning, FL）提供了一种去中心化且保护隐私的训练范式，使其成为医疗保健应用的理想解决方案。医疗保健中的一个关键挑战是，真实世界医疗数据在局部和全局视图中常呈现长尾分布。解决长尾FL问题的现有方法通常假设模型将在均匀测试数据分布上评估。然而，医疗保健系统中的实际测试数据往往不可知且不可预测，导致模型在真实世界场景中可能失败。本文引入一个称为测试不可知长尾联邦学习（Test-Agnostic Long-Tailed Federated Learning）的新任务，并提出GTAFL，一个应对该挑战的综合框架。在训练阶段，GTAFL采用自适应重采样、专家分类器重训练和自监督学习，以纠正由长尾训练分布导致的有偏分类器和扭曲特征空间。在推理阶段，集成机制组合重训练的专家分类器，以处理分布未知的测试数据。在CIFAR10和两个医学数据集上的大量实验表明，我们的框架优于其他最先进方法。代码可在https://github.com/cgy-lavine/GTAFL获取。
